Job Description:
Architecte Cybersécurité (f/h)

CE QUE NOUS FAISONS :

NOUS SOMMES LES PIONNIERS DE LA CYBERSÉCURITÉ DANS LA DÉFENSE ET L'AÉROSPATIALE
Vous souhaitez en faire partie? Nous recherchons toute l'année des personnes talentueuses et engagées telles que vous pour nous rejoindre!
Airbus Defence and Space Cyber est un leader européen de la cybersécurité, opérant notamment dans les domaines de l'aérospatiale et de la défense. Ce sont d'abord nos équipes qui font la différence: Plus de 800 spécialistes, hautement qualifiés, venant d'horizons divers, travaillent ensemble pour développer et déployer des solutions de cybersécurité sur mesure qui protègent les clients gouvernementaux, militaires et institutionnels. Ils sont tous animés par une même ambition: contribuer à renforcer la sécurité et la stabilité de nos organisations et de nos nations.

Rejoignez l'équipe Airbus !

VOTRE RÔLE : Airbus Defence and Space Cyber recherche un/une Architecte Cybersécurité (f/h) pour rejoindre notre pôle Architecture Sécurité des Systèmes d’Information basé à Toulouse (Site du Palays),France.

Vous ferez partie d'une équipe qui développe des solutions de cybersécurité critiques pour des clients de haute importance. Dans le cadre de notre département d’ingénierie dédié aux projets, vous serez impliqué(e) dans la conception globale de la sécurité des systèmes d’information visant à garantir la protection des données et des infrastructures de nos clients.

Ce qui rend ce rôle unique est la diversité des enjeux : vous travaillerez sur des projets de haute importance pour les intitutions européennes, le Ministère des Armées, les ministères régaliens. C'est une opportunité idéale pour un expert en sécurité souhaitant évoluer vers la conception et l'architecture dans un environnement de défense et de souveraineté.

COMMENT VOUS ALLEZ CONTRIBUER À L'ÉQUIPE : Votre mission sera de transformer les besoins de sécurité en architectures concrètes et robustes. Vos principales responsabilités seront :
- Conception et Ingénierie : Rédaction des exigences de sécurité et conception des architectures fonctionnelles et techniques des systèmes d'information.
- Accompagnement à l'Homologation : Réalisation d'analyses de risques et rédaction des dossiers d'homologation pour garantir la conformité des systèmes.
- Appui à la construction du système : Accompagnement des phases d'intégration, de validation et de maintien en condition opérationnelle et de sécurité (MCO/MCS).
- Support Commercial : Participation active aux réponses aux appels d'offres par l'élaboration de solutions techniques et l'estimation des coûts.
- Innovation et Veille : Identification des technologies émergentes et proposition de solutions innovantes (automatisation, Zero Trust, etc.) pour maintenir un niveau de résilience de pointe.
- Expertise et Leadership : Animation de réunions techniques, Pilotage techniques d'activtés, présentation et défense de vos architectures lors de soutenances ou de Groupes de Travail (GT SSI).

A PROPOS DE VOUS :
- Expertise Technique en Sécurité : Expérience significative dans la conception et l'intégration de la sécurité de systèmes d'information (systèmes d'exploitation, gestion des identités/IAM, réseaux, PKI, virtualisation ou Cloud).
- Capacité de Conception : Aptitude à passer de l'analyse de risques à la définition d'une architecture technique, avec une bonne maîtrise des méthodes d'ingénierie (Cycle en V ou Agile).
- Aisance Relationnelle et Rédactionnelle : Excellentes capacités de synthèse et de rédaction, ainsi qu'une aisance pour présenter et défendre des sujets techniques complexes devant des interlocuteurs variés.
- Anglais Professionnel : Bonne maîtrise de l'anglais, tant à l'oral qu'à l'écrit.
- Profil Évolutif : Vous possédez une solide expérience en sécurité et souhaitez donner un nouvel élan à votre carrière en devenant Architecte.

Un plus pour votre candidature (Expérience dans le domaine Spatial) :
- Une connaissance ou une expérience des enjeux de cybersécurité appliqués au secteur spatial (sol/satellite).
- La maîtrise des contraintes spécifiques aux systèmes embarqués critiques et à la sécurisation des flux de données satellites constitue un avantage majeur.

VOTRE EMPLACEMENT : Toulouse, France (Site du Palays) Situé au cœur de la capitale européenne de l'aéronautique et du spatial, le site du Palays est un centre d'excellence stratégique pour Airbus Defence and Space. Toulouse offre un cadre de vie dynamique, alliant innovation technologique, richesse culturelle et proximité avec les Pyrénées.

VOYAGES : Voyages occasionnels vers France et Europe.

PARCE QUE NOUS PRENONS SOIN DE VOUS:
- Avantages financiers: Salaire attractif, accords d’intéressement et de participation, plan d'épargne salariale abondé par Airbus, plan d’actionnariat salarié sur la base du volontariat, avec attribution d'actions gratuites en fonction du nombre d'actions souscrites.

- Équilibre vie privée / professionnelle : 30 jours de congés, des jours de congés supplémentaires pour les occasions spéciales ou pour raisons familiales, des options de transfert de congés, un Comité d'Entreprise proposant de nombreuses activités socio-culturelles et sportives et d’autres services.

- Bien-être / santé : Couverture complémentaire des frais de santé et de prévoyance (incapacité, invalidité, décès). Selon le site : centre de services de santé, services de conciergerie, salle de sport, application de covoiturage.

- Développement individuel : Des opportunités d’évolution et de nombreuses possibilités de formations avec un catalogue de plus de 10 000 e-formations disponibles en libre accès pour développer votre employabilité, certifications, programmes de développement accéléré, parcours expert, mobilité nationale et internationale.

Chez Airbus, nous vous aidons à travailler et à collaborer plus facilement et de manière plus flexible. Dans la mesure du possible, nous favorisons des modes de travail flexibles afin de stimuler l'esprit d'innovation

Notre monde change. Et nous aussi. De notre engagement pour un vol zéro carbone (#ZÉRO) à nettoyer l'espace, la durabilité est au cœur de notre objectif. Alors quel est votre prochain changement ?

Job Description:
Airbus Commercial Aircraft is looking for a Backup Architect (f/m) to join our DIC public and private cloud team based in Toulouse, France.

You will be part of a team developing IT Backup Services, IT Resilience, and Cyber security for Hosting. As part of the DIC public and private cloud team, you will be involved in driving the strategy, design, and implementation of our backup services aiming at securing our critical information assets, ensuring they are recoverable and compliant with regulatory standards.

Your working environment:

Global capital of aeronautics and European capital for space research, Toulouse is a dynamic city in the southwest of France served by an international airport. Ideally located between the Mediterranean sea and the Atlantic ocean and close to the Pyrenees mountains, it offers plenty of options for outdoor activities!

How we care for you:
- Financial rewards: Attractive salary, agreements on success and profit sharing schemes, employee savings plan abounded by Airbus and employee stock purchase plan on a voluntary basis.

- Work / Life Balance: Extra days-off for special occasions, holiday transfer option, a Staff council offering many social, cultural and sport activities and other services.

- Wellbeing / Health: Complementary health insurance coverage (disability, invalidity, death). Depending on the site: health services center, concierge services, gym, carpooling application.

- Individual development: Great upskilling opportunities and development prospects with unlimited access to +10.000 e-learning courses to develop your employability, certifications, expert career path, accelerated development programmes, national and international mobility.

At Airbus, we support you to work, connect and collaborate more easily and flexibly. Wherever possible, we foster flexible working arrangements to stimulate innovative thinking.

Your challenges:
- Develop and maintain a long-term data protection strategy and technology roadmap for hybrid, multi-cloud, container, and on-premise environments.

- Lead the technical design of scalable, resilient, and secure Disaster Recovery architectures, ensuring robust failover capabilities.

- Evaluate emerging technologies (immutable backups, air-gapped storage) to continuously modernize the data protection stack and reduce technical debt.

- Drive the automation and orchestration of backup and recovery processes to improve efficiency and minimize the risk of human error.

- Act as the technical authority and highest escalation point for complex data recovery failures, bridging operations, security, and business continuity.

Your boarding pass:
- Significant professional experience in IT Infrastructure, with a strong focus on Backup and Recovery Architecture.

- Deep knowledge of Enterprise Backup platforms (Veritas, Cohesity, Veeam) and storage technologies (SAN, NAS, DAS, Object Storage).

- Strong understanding of virtualization platforms, database backup methodologies, cloud, and container technologies.

- Solid grasp of security strategies including ransomware protection, encryption, and Zero Trust architecture.

- Strong analytical thinking, crisis management skills, and the ability to communicate technical risks effectively to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

Not a 100% match? No worries! Airbus supports your personal growth with customized development solutions.

postings.title: Business Lead - Identity Compliance
postings.description:
Job Description:

Description

Airbus is seeking a highly motivated Business Lead to join our Identity Compliance team in Bangalore, India. This role is pivotal within the Digital function, bridging the gap between enterprise risk requirements and technical execution.

The Business Lead is responsible for driving global business engagement, identity compliance strategy, and the execution of access certification campaigns. You will translate complex risk requirements into effective governance policies while driving stakeholder adoption and risk mitigation across the organization.

About Us

The Airbus DSF (Foundations, Extended Enterprise, and Roof Security) organization provides critical IT and security services to employees globally. Our Identity Compliance team focuses on improving digital cybersecurity maturity by securing identities and access, enabling robust security controls through advanced Identity and Access Management (IAM) frameworks.

The Business Lead - Identity compliance will work with the Product Manager and platform lead for Identity compliance. Security for Identity is improving digital cybersecurity maturity and effectiveness by securing identities, accounts and accesses. Its aims at enabling the business and security controls focusing on Identity and Access management.

Qualification & Experience
- Graduate or Post Graduate degree with 8+ years of experience in Cybersecurity, Identity Governance, or Compliance.

- Deep expertise in Identity Governance and Administration (IGA) frameworks, including risk-based access recertifications, Segregation of Duties (SoD), and Least Privilege enforcement.

- Strong understanding of compliance standards such as ISO 27001 and GDPR, with experience collaborating with audit teams.

- Proven ability to influence senior leadership and communicate complex risk concepts to non-technical stakeholders.

- Experience in driving change management, user awareness, and training programs for identity compliance initiatives.

- Proficiency in refining business requirements into functional IGA specifications using tools like Radiant Logic, Brainwave GRC, or SailPoint.

- Experience with IGA business workflows (e.g., Radiant Logic, Brainwave GRC, SailPoint or similar) and management tools like Confluence and Zoho.

- Strong project management skills for overseeing large scale compliance campaigns or implementation initiatives.

-

Tasks & Accountabilities

As the successful candidate your main tasks & accountabilities are:
- Lead the planning and execution of periodic risk-based access reviews, ensuring high completion rates and remediation.

- Act as the primary interface for application owners and stakeholders, guiding them through compliance workflows and remediation.

- Define and enforce business risk rules and entitlement catalog governance to minimize unauthorized access exposure.

- Collaborate with IAM teams and security stakeholders to align security policies with global business requirements.

- Serve as the Subject Matter Expert (SME) for compliance audits, resolving findings and demonstrating control effectiveness.

- Develop and report business-focused compliance KPIs and executive dashboards to track recertification progress.

- Manage vendor relationships and gather operational requirements to prioritize platform features and technical updates.

- Provide guidance and leadership for business escalations during campaign execution, ensuring corporate security targets are met.

Feel like you can't tick some boxes above? If you have most of the skills and experience that we're looking for and are willing to use your talent to learn the rest, we encourage you to apply!

postings.title: Computing Engineer
postings.description:
Job Description:
Responsible for the stability, security, and efficiency of the enterprise endpoint computing environment in the China region. Focuses on automated script deployment, patch management, and compliance enforcement leveraging SCCM/MECM platforms. Acts as the Tier 3 technical escalation specialist for Service Desk and Onsite teams, and serves as the primary regional technology liaison collaborating with European/Global teams to align standards with unique Chinese regulatory and business requirements.
ACCOUNTABILITY
SCCM Platform Administration & Software Lifecycle Management :
- Administer the SCCM platform and manage structured device collections to centrally govern China-region endpoint assets.

- Orchestrate end-to-end software lifecycle operations, including packaging, deployment, automated upgrades, and silent removals of unauthorized software via Service Requests (SRs) and Change Requests (CRs).

- Design and publish comprehensive SSRS/SQL reports tracking hardware inventory, real-time software licensing and distribution statuses.

Patch Management & Security Compliance:
- Collaborate with global Patch Management teams to schedule and execute enterprise security patch deployments via SCCM, ensuring alignment with global maintenance windows.

- Conduct vulnerability analysis and administer Roof China Windows Server Update Services (WSUS) and SCCM patching pipelines, ensuring proactive mitigation of vulnerabilities and alignment with global cybersecurity baselines.

- Monitor and analyze endpoint patch compliance reports across the regional infrastructure, conducting deep-dive Root Cause Analysis (RCA) and executing technical remediations for non-compliant, offline, or patch-failed devices.

- Develop and deploy automated remediation scripts and tools (e.g., PowerShell) to resolve recurring patch installation bottlenecks, significantly reducing manual troubleshooting overhead.

Tier 3 Technical Support & Global OS Collaboration:
- Act as a top-tier (Tier 3) escalation point for critical incidents, leading problem resolution efforts in a high-pressure, mission-critical environment.

- Provision and distribute standardized Windows OS images and deployment media to Helpdesk team.

- China OS imaging and hardware compatibility support (technical diagnostics & structured feedback), coordinating with European teams for root-cause resolutions.

- Enforce Windows OS configuration baselines and custom functional policies (e.g., power management, security baselines).

Documentation, Knowledge Transfer & Training:
- Create and maintain comprehensive, high-quality technical documentation, standard operating procedures, and troubleshooting guides.

- Provide expert-level knowledge transfer and training to internal IT teams and key business users.

Project Management
- Define project scope, goals, and deliverables that support business objectives in collaboration with senior management and stakeholders.

- Develop comprehensive project plans, including timelines, milestones, and resource allocation.

- Create and manage project budgets, tracking expenditures and ensuring projects are delivered within financial guidelines.

QUALIFICATION
EDUCATION: Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or a related technical field.
EXPERIENCE:
- 8 - 10 years of progressive IT experience in an enterprise-level MNC environment, with at least 3-5 years in a senior engineering role focused specifically on Endpoint Management (SCCM/MECM), Windows OS Imaging, and Tier 3 Technical Escalation.

- Project Leadership: Proven track record of managing complex technical initiatives, including scoping, resource allocation, budget tracking, and cross-functional stakeholder communication.

CERTIFICATION:
Highly Desirable: Microsoft Certified: Endpoint Administrator Associate (Modern Desktop / MCSA / MCSE equivalent certifications).
Advantageous: ITIL Foundation, PMP, or related IT service delivery certifications.

LANGUAGE: fluent English both in written and oral speaking
KNOWLEDGE / TECHNICAL SKILLS:
Endpoint Management (SCCM/MECM): Expert-level, hands-on experience administering Microsoft Endpoint Configuration Manager (MECM/SCCM), including dynamic/static device collections, application packaging, deployment orchestration, and client health remediation.
In-depth understanding and practical experience managing enterprise WSUS and SCCM patching pipelines. Proficiency in diagnosing patch failure logs (WMI corruption, Windows Update Agent errors, system policy conflicts) and driving vulnerability remediations to meet strict SLAs.
Deep expertise in Windows Operating System architecture (Windows 10/11), WIM golden image customization, hardware driver integration, task sequences, and provisioning deployment media for Helpdesk teams.

postings.description:
Job Description:
Take off with Airbus Helicopters !

Airbus Helicopters is looking for a Corporate Cybersecurity & Compliance Expert (m/f) to join the Corporate Digital Security team based in Marignane, France.

Join us to shape the future of aeronautics and help protect lives during missions accomplished thanks to our helicopters.

The Marignane site, the 3rd largest industrial site in France, near Marseille and Aix-en-Provence, is undergoing a deep transformation to offer a high-tech, inclusive, and environmentally friendly working environment.

You will live a unique professional experience, at the heart of the manufacturing of our helicopters.

To learn more about our site and our activities : Airbus Helicopters – Marignane. You will enjoy a unique professional experience at the very heart of our helicopter manufacturing operations.

To find out more about our site and activities: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=flu57j6g-0g

Your future missions :

By joining our team, you will ensure the protection and resilience of our assets against cyber threats, while ensuring compliance with national and international regulatory standards.

Together, we will strengthen the Corporate Security department's efforts in protecting our products and ensuring their compliance with regulations.

The general mission of the Corporate Security department is to protect employees, tangible and intangible assets, as well as the reputation of Airbus Helicopters against any physical, digital, or strategic threat, in order to guarantee business continuity.

Your main missions will be :

- Compliance & Regulation : Lead compliance projects for national and international cybersecurity regulations (e.g., NIS 2, CRA) and provide operational support to the Standardization Compliance Manager.
- Governance & Aircraft Security : Ensure digital signature governance to strengthen aircraft protection, supporting the Products & Services Security Manager.
- Risk Management & Cyber Processes: Actively contribute to GRC (Governance, Risk, and Compliance) activities and the optimization of associated cybersecurity processes.
- Support & Awareness : Conduct advisory, awareness and regulatory assistance initiatives for internal teams.
- Transnational Collaboration & Coordination : Work in close synergy with Airbus Helicopters IT security managers globally and participate in Airbus Group working groups.

Your profile :

Professional Experience Level :

- Solid experience in complying with national and international cybersecurity regulations.

Job-Related Technical Expertise :

- In-depth knowledge of European regulations: NIS 2, CRA, PART-IS.
- In-depth knowledge of project management.
- Risk Analysis: Mastery of the EBIOS RM methodology.
- In-depth knowledge of electronic signature solutions, data protection, and data integrity and authenticity control. Knowledge of ARINC 835, 827, and 665 is a plus.
- Architecture & Networks : Good knowledge of secure network architectures, partitioning, cryptography, operating systems (Linux/RTOS/Windows), and security solutions (SOC, SIEM, firewalls, bastions).
- Languages: French (native/fluent), professional fluent English.

Soft Skills :

- Rigor and Integrity: Strict adherence to regulatory procedures and absolute confidentiality.
- Pedagogy and Communication : Ability to explain security challenges to both technical teams and decision-makers.
- Analytical and Synthesis Mindset : Ability to translate complex technical issues into decision-making summaries.
- Stress Management and Responsiveness : Composure in incident or crisis situations.
- Team Spirit : Ability to work in integrated, cross-functional, and transnational teams.

Special Conditions :

- Security Clearance : Position requires obtaining Secret-level defense security clearance.
- Occasional national and international travel.

3 Reasons to join us :

Our Values : Six essential values form the core of our company. Defined for employees by employees, our Airbus values shape the DNA of our business, reflecting the unique mix of qualities found in each member of our global family.
Inclusion and diversity : We foster an inclusive and rewarding work environment, where everyone's diversity is valued and respected. An inclusive and diverse workforce is the engine of innovation at Airbus. It makes us unique and contributes to better problem-solving.

Compensation and benefits :

At Airbus, we build the future together and your success is our priority.
Expect a global, competitive, and transparent compensation package (including salaries, bonuses, profit-sharing, participation, and preferred share ownership plan), designed to reward the impact and performance you bring, both individually and collectively.
We invest in your complete well-being: professional development (training, mentoring, international mobility), health coverage, retirement, and a commitment to a supported work-life balance (parental support, flexibility).

And for your daily life, benefits that make a difference :

- A dynamic CSE (Social and Economic Committee) offering many advantages (company restaurant, children's leisure center, associations and sports complex, travel allowances, etc.).
- Transport facilities: Take advantage of our company shuttles or the reimbursement of your annual transport pass.

Rejoignez-nous pour façonner l'avenir de l'aéronautique et contribuer à protéger des vies lors des missions accomplies grâce à nos hélicoptères.

Le site de Marignane, 3ème site industriel français, près de Marseille et d'Aix-en-Provence se transforme en profondeur pour offrir un environnement de travail de haute technologie, inclusif et respectueux de l'environnement.

En rejoignant notre équipe, vous assurerez la protection et la résilience de nos biens face aux cybermenaces, tout en veillant au respect des normes réglementaires nationales et internationales applicables aux secteurs civil et militaire.

Ensemble, nous renforcerons l’action du département Corporate Security, avec un accent particulier sur la protection des informations relatives à la défense et à la sécurité nationale.

Job Description:
In order to support our Digital Security Team, Airbus Defence and Space is looking for a

Cyber Detection Engineering Lead (d/f/m)

Role Overview
To support our Digital Security Team, Airbus Defence and Space division is seeking a highly skilled Leader Role for Detection Engineer (d/f/m). This is a critical, high-impact role designed to actively protect our entire organization and our world-class products.
This is a technical, hands-on position that sits at the heart of our defense strategy. You will not simply respond to alerts; you will be the architect of our detection ecosystem—transforming threat intelligence into high-fidelity detection logic and bridging the gap between raw telemetry and actionable security intelligence.

Your location
Our site is just a stone's throw away from Munich, the beautiful capital of Bavaria. You are into sports and other outdoor activities? The Alps and Lake Starnberg are within an hour’s reach, offering a multitude of recreational options. Possible work locations include Manching, Taufkirchen/Ottobrunn, Immenstaad am Bodensee, and Ulm.

Our Benefits for You
- Fair Compensation & Extras: Attractive remuneration and individual additional benefits, such as company pension schemes, mobility offers (e.g., bike leasing), or corporate discounts with partner companies in accordance with our current guidelines.

- Time for You (and Your Loved Ones): 30 days of annual leave based on our collective agreement (35-hour week); work-life balance through flexible working hours (flextime), mobile working, part-time options, job sharing, and sabbatical opportunities.

- Growth Made Easy: Excellent professional development opportunities and international, group-wide career perspectives.

- Feel Good at Work: On-site company doctor; comprehensive health programs (sports courses, preventive care, etc.), canteen and cafeteria, and local childcare facilities at selected locations.

- Diversity Connects: Work in a diverse environment with more than 140 nationalities, where exchange, mutual support, and inclusion are part of our DNA.

Your tasks and responsibilities
- Lead Detection Strategy: Define the long-term vision for detection engineering, aligning technical roadmaps with organizational risk profiles while standardizing the development lifecycle.

- Engine & Rule Lifecycle Management: Architect, develop, maintain, and optimize high-fidelity detection rules for the SOC while expanding framework coverage against MITRE ATT&CK® and Sigma standards.

- Threat Intelligence Translation: Analyze Cyber Threat Intelligence (CTI) and translate complex TTPs into proactive, resilient detection logic.

- Automation & Orchestration: Drive "Detection-as-Code" initiatives and engineer automated response playbooks to streamline incident response and minimize manual intervention.

- Technical Mentorship & Escalation: Act as the primary escalation point for complex technical issues, mentoring junior detection engineers and SOC analysts.

- Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner closely with Incident Response and SOC teams to ensure deployment of context-rich detections that enable rapid threat containment.

Desired skills and qualifications
- Degree in Computer Science, Cybersecurity, Information Technology, or equivalent practical experience.

- Proven track record in developing use cases and detection logic within a Security Operations Center (SOC) environment, including leadership or mentorship experience.

- Strong proficiency in Python and hands-on experience with automation frameworks to streamline operations.

- Deep technical expertise in Windows and Linux operating systems, including OS internals, system logging, and telemetry analysis.

- Practical background in Red Teaming, Penetration Testing, or an offensive mindset to anticipate attacker methodologies.

- Advanced expertise with the MITRE ATT&CK® framework and Detection-as-Code concepts.

- Strong communication skills with an empathetic, collaborative approach to leading cross-functional teams and technical initiatives.

Not a 100% match? No worries! Airbus supports your personal growth with customized development solutions.

Job Description:
Description:
Airbus is on its Digital journey and the objective is to transform the company and to prepare it for the future. This transformation includes new global governance, new ways of working and the implementation of digital business services and platforms. As a part of this transformation journey we
have set up a GIC in the silicon valley of India - Bangalore. This state of the art GIC is responsible for driving excellence in IT and OT for Airbus.
Challenges are numerous and exciting.!

About the team & the Role

Security threats have increased drastically in the last few years and organisations are facing an increasingly complex threat landscape. As Airbus continues its digital transformation, numerous opportunities emerge along with new risks.
The Security Architects are in charge of providing Cybersecurity consultancy and support to business teams and projects within Airbus Digital function; Contribute to the roll-out of the Security-by-Design architecture; Represent Airbus Digital Security department as secure design ambassadors; Create
privileged partnership with major business domains and efficiently contribute to the design and the architecture of new solutions and backbones.

As a Cyber Security Architect, you will:

postings.title: Cyber Security Evaluator (d/f/m) Airborne Products
postings.description:
Job Description:

In order to support our operations, Airbus Commercial is looking for a

Cyber Security Evaluator (d/f/m)

Airbus is a global industrial player and aircraft manufacturer with the highest standards of safety and security. The increasing connectivity of our aircraft and the digitalization of our products have opened the door to new threats and hence to a growing need for security evaluation activities.
To face these challenges, our team, embedded in the Flight and Integration Test Center, acts as the first attacker to anticipate the threats our airborne products could face. Composed of specialists combining multiple competencies in avionics, networks, radio transmissions, operating systems, cryptography and more. This transnational team is recognized company-wide for its unique expertise combining avionics and security skills.

To extend our activities and scope, we are currently looking for a Cyber Security Evaluator (m/f/d) for airborne products, based in Hamburg-Finkenwerder, Germany. Your main role is to perform security evaluations on airborne products and systems and to identify security weaknesses before their entry into service or affecting the in-service aircraft. As our environment is constantly evolving, you also contribute actively to the continuous improvement of our activities by exploring new attack techniques, tracking new technologies, developing scripts and tools supporting the security evaluation of airborne products.

Are you ready for this challenge?

Your Location

You will be working at the largest production site for civil aircraft situated in Hamburg. Its location on the southern banks of the river Elbe includes the option to commute by ferry. Experience the special flair of Hamburg in your spare time where vibrant cosmopolitan culture meets nautic legacy.

What you will do with us as Airborne Products Cyber Security Evaluator (m/f):

- Using your curiosity, creativity and experience, to develop and perform adversarial security evaluations against Airbus airborne products and related services in our laboratory test environments.
- To evaluate the security of our products and systems, gathering system or multi-system configuration items and performing configuration reviews.
- To contribute to the design, development, implementation and integration of Airbus airborne products applying an attacker mindset and sharing technical expertise with our international community of system designers and developers.
- To identify weaknesses and/or vulnerabilities on hardware & software by using diverse techniques and tools.
- To compile technical reports and presentations to describe findings, to recommend fixes and to support the security risk analysis process.
- To disseminate your developed attack scenarios and obtain technical knowledge within our team
- To contribute to research and development to explore innovative ways to evaluate Airbus products security.
- To develop tools and test means to test airborne systems.

This role will involve some travel for business in Europe and worldwide, and as such, you must be able to travel accordingly.

We are looking for candidates with the following skills and qualities, please do not hesitate to apply (in English) for the position, even if you partially fulfill the list below:

Experience:
- Industrial experience in cyber security evaluations and penetration testing.
- Advanced knowledge of computer science. A diploma in Cyber Security will be appreciated but not mandatory.
- Experience regarding network security
- Reverse engineering of binaries and/or low-level programming experience
- Software development skills to support security evaluations (tooling, etc)
- Experience in CTF (Capture The Flag) challenges is appreciated.

Hard skills:
- Network-related attack techniques (scanning, spoofing and exploitation of wired and wireless communication)
- Deep knowledge on Linux-based systems
- Knowledge of virtualization and containerization solutions
- Tool development in Python
- Vulnerability research techniques (on source or object code): static analysis, dynamic analysis (fuzzing, concolic execution, …) of: C, C++, Python, Java, Bash or other languages
- Knowledge of different architectures (ARM, PowerPC, x86(_64) or FPGA) is helpful
- Radio Frequency skills are appreciated. Knowledge of GPS/GNSS, 4G/5G is a plus.

Softskills:
- Team spirit, curiosity, creativity.
- Aim to develop the ability to communicate effectively and comprehensively to present complex technical approaches and findings.
- Strong analytical and organizational skills with good communication skills in English.

Please include your starting date and salary expectations in your application and apply in English.

Why join us?

1 - Work on adversarial security evaluation for the Airbus airborne product portfolio, incl. aircraft and helicopter equipment and be an active contributor to the safety and security of aviation.
2 - Work in a multicultural environment, on a growing spectrum of activities, on a worldwide perimeter, within a team of security evaluation specialists.
3 - You will have the opportunity to apply your expertise, to develop your skills, competencies and your personal project. You will attend some specialized Cyber Security conferences.
4 - Work in a balanced environment: beyond the many benefits offered to its employees, joining Airbus is also the guarantee of a respectable work-life balance.

Your Benefits

- Fair Compensation & Extras: Attractive remuneration and individual additional benefits, such as company pension schemes, mobility offers (e.g., bike leasing), or corporate discounts with partner companies in accordance with our current guidelines.
- Time for You (and Your Loved Ones): 30 days of annual leave based on our collective agreement (35-hour week); work-life balance through flexible working hours (flextime), mobile working, part-time options, job sharing, and sabbatical opportunities.
- Growth Made Easy: Excellent professional development opportunities and international, group-wide career perspectives.
- Feel Good at Work: On-site company doctor; comprehensive health programs (sports courses, preventive care, etc.), canteen and cafeteria, and local childcare facilities at selected locations.
- Diversity Connects: Work in a diverse environment with more than 140 nationalities, where exchange, mutual support, and inclusion are part of our DNA.

Job Description:
Are you ready to secure the final frontier?

As space assets become increasingly vital to global security, the need for specialized protection has never been greater. We are looking for a dedicated security professional to take end-to-end security responsibility for our Spanish Space Domain.

The Role:

Protect the Spanish Space Business: Space Security Specialist Wanted

We are looking for a Cyber Security Specialist to take full, end-to-end responsibility for our Space Domain. This is a unique opportunity to manage the entire security lifecycle: from the first blueprint to the active defense of our assets. As the guardian of our space Customer , your work will bridge the gap between high-level architecture and hands-on operational excellence.

Your Mission:

- You will Architect: You will design secure systems and perform compliance checks and risk assessments to ensure our space-based assets are built to last.

- You will Strengthen:

- You will liaise and consult with our internal customers according to cyber security standards and support them in achieving their goals, including mission-critical projects reaching as far as Mars.

- You will define the standard for our systems by creating hardening guidelines and taking ownership of product security.

- You will Defend: You will lead our operational defense by managing security technologies (e.g. EDR), driving proactive vulnerability management, and ensuring our network remains secure through efficient, streamlined security request management (firewall and access control ticketing).

What you bring:
- A deep toolkit of cyber security skills, from architectural design to operational defense.

- Experience with vulnerability management and endpoint protection

- The ability to turn complex security requirements into clear, practical hardening guidelines.

- Broad IT technology knowledge to develop security architectures and to be able to find security weaknesses

- A proactive mindset: You don't just find problems; you design the solutions.

- CISSP or similar certification is an advantage.

- Basic knowledge of conducting audits is an advantage

- Excellent communication skills to act as a security partner to our engineering teams

- Openness and willingness to face new technological developments

Join us:

A well-motivated team of security and technology enthusiasts in an international environment. We don't just react to threats; we stay steps ahead through a dedicated "defense in depth" philosophy. Thus, you are key in helping us stay steps ahead of the bad guys in the most challenging domain on Earth and beyond.

With around 130,000 employees and as the largest aeronautics and space company in Europe and a worldwide leader, Airbus is at the forefront of the aviation industry, connecting people and places via air and space.

Our world is changing. And so are we. From our commitment to zero-carbon flight (#ZEROe) to cleaning up space, sustainability is at the hear t of our purpose. So what's your next change?

Join our Digital Security Operation Team and be at the forefront of developing the next generation of defense systems.

You will play a crucial role in defining and executing Cybersecurity Technologies and Procedures to mitigate both short and long-term threats and risks within our dynamic, international environment.

• You will maintain and manage security products, including EDR, multi-antivirus solutions, and email sandboxing tools.

ABOUT YOU

• Experience managing advanced security solutions, including EDR and email threat protection tools.
• Proven expertise in performing threat modeling to identify and mitigate architectural security risks.
• Experience designing and overseeing an enterprise-wide Vulnerability Management Program using Tenable.

Job Description:
WHY JOIN US?

📍 LIFE IN ALBACETE: QUALITY & CONVENIENCE - Forget long commutes. Albacete offers you the great advantage of a “15-minute city": safe, accessible, comfortable and perfectly connected. Enjoy a premium standard of living at a
competitive cost, ensuring you have the perfect balance between your career and your personal life.

helicopter production, offering you endless potential to grow alongside our major projects. Bring your ideas to a dynamic, modern ecosystem and help us build the next generation of aerospace solutions.

DESCRIPTION
Are you a Cybersecurity professional who loves bridging the gap between technical controls and global standards? Or an IT Infrastructure professional looking to pivot into security?
We are looking for a Cybersecurity & Compliance Specialist to join our team. In this role, you won't just check compliance boxes; you will be the cornerstone that ensures our systems, networks, and projects are both highly secure and compliant with international standards.

- Secure the Foundation: Maintain and improve our ISMS in alignment with global frameworks (or equivalent practical experience).

- Hands-on Hardening: Define and review technical security controls (network security, system hardening, and DR/BCP plans).

- Secure by Design: Partner with IT and Network teams to embed Zero Trust principles into new projects.

What We Are Looking For
- Background: A degree in Computer Science, Telecommunications or a related field

- Experience: Solid experience in Cybersecurity or IT (Systems Administration, Network Engineering,…). We highly value transferable technical skills.

- Security Mindset: Familiarity with framework implementation (ISO 27001, NIS2, ENS, or similar).

- Project & Problem Solving: Proven ability to manage technical tasks or projects autonomously, with a proactive, solution-oriented approach.

- Languages: Full Professional in English and Spanish is mandatory.

Nice-to-Haves (Bonus points, Not Dealbreakers)
- Industry certifications such as CISSP, CISA, CRISC, or ISO 27001 Lead Auditor.

- Experience with GRC, Risk Methodologies (Magerit, EBIOS) or regulatory standards (CCN-STIC).

- Knowledge of French.

postings.title: Cybersecurity Architect (All Gender)
postings.description:
Job Description:
Within our teams, the Confirmed Enterprise Cybersecurity Architect ensures that the technical and technological choices of IT and business projects respect the organization's security strategy.

It constitutes the technical security authority on corporate IS architectures, defines security models and supports the development of architectures, consistent with the IT strategy and security policies of the organization.

You will work on high-stakes activities sometimes combining notions of safety (operation, people), production issues for companies or strategic sectors of the group and for our external clients.

The role:

Your activities as an Enterprise Cybersecurity Architect will be structured around 4 main themes and typical activities:

Design:
- Establish the IS security architecture strategy in line with the business strategy, the security objectives resulting from risk analysis and the overall security strategy of the company
- Define and apply reference models for architectures
- Contribute to the translation of security policies into operational security standards

Recommendation:
- Support projects in the design of the architecture, specify the different settings and define the technical security requirements
- Advise on the choice of technical solutions and recommend secure architectures for IS; ensure regulatory compliance where applicable
- Regularly review the existing architecture, identify gaps and make recommendations for security improvements
- Define security testing and validation strategies and ensure follow-up of recommendations

Advice:
- Advise on the use and combination of existing security bricks
- Analyze security issues linked to the introduction of new technologies or new information systems
- Ensure technological monitoring and take it into account in the definition of security architectures

Communication:
- Contribute to the increase in security maturity of IS with technical architects and urban planners
- Collaborate with technical security specialists to consolidate a global view of defensive IT security
- Popularize your technical knowledge with other technical and non-technical functions.

Are you THE one ?

- You have an engineering school degree (or equivalent) in the field of cybersecurity, OR you have significant experience in cybersecurity.
- You have at least 5 years of experience in security and have worked on major projects in several sectors (Transport, Space, Pharmaceuticals, Banking, etc.)
- You know how to implement the principles of defensive security and know how to carry out your activity independently.

In particular, you know how to highlight several skills in the following themes:
- Secure architecture design
- PKI (Public key infrastructure)
- Cloud
- Cryptography
- Identity and access rights management (IAM)
- Network security and communication protocols
- Security in operating systems

Skills in one of the following areas are also a plus (optional):
- Design methods, System engineering and security
- Security Product Configuration and Hardening
- Systems auditability and incident management

We also expect the following behavioral skills from our experienced employees:
- Able to work cross-functionally within the organization, you do not hesitate to help profiles more junior than you and be a contributor to the Security Architecture Center of Competencies
- A curious and dynamic mind
- Adaptability to different situations and autonomy in your missions
- You begin to develop skills around leadership, self-confidence and sharing
- You begin to develop an interest in security standards and regulations and their relevance and application in your missions

Finally, we also place particular importance on your technical development, expertise and team spirit in our skills centers. You will therefore join technical communities whose objectives are to create this spirit, disseminate knowledge and bring your ideas to life!

As a confirmed profile we will also pay particular attention to the transmission of knowledge to your peers and to technical capitalization. If you are proactive, we are committed to supporting you in bringing your ideas to life!

As an international company, we work in a multicultural environment: an advanced English level is mandatory.

Your recruitment process:

We value human contact. In order to get to know you better, here are the usual steps of our recruitment process after analyzing your application:
● Application file to be filled in, sent by your recruitment officer.
● Technical interview with the manager.
● Interview with the Recruitment Officer.
● Personalized feedback after the process

Your position will be based in Getafe:
Located just 13 km south of Madrid, Getafe is one of Southern Europe’s major technological and industrial hubs.
As a key center for aerospace, defense, and high-tech industries, it offers an exceptional professional environment to work alongside leading experts and drive cutting-edge innovation.
It offers the perfect balance between a booming career and the famous Spanish lifestyle.

35 hours per week // Flexible working hours // Hybrid working options available depending on the role // Half day Fridays! // 25 days holiday plus bank holidays

About us:

Airbus Corporate PKI is a mission-critical Information Management (IM) service hosted in a secure enclave infrastructure and managed by the Airbus Commercial Aircraft Digital Security & Platforms team. The platform’s architecture and operational policies strictly align with ATA Spec 42 and Airbus Certificate Policy (CP) standards, ensuring compliance with Airworthiness Authorities' Field Loadable Software Security requirements for airplanes and helicopters.

Within the Digital Certificates product scope, our goal is to evolve the technical and functional capabilities of the Corporate PKI solution to continuously fulfill aerospace, governmental, and cybersecurity regulations.

What you will be doing:

As a Cybersecurity Business Analyst, you will collaborate directly with cross-functional technical and operations teams to refine requirements, implement system updates, and ensure operational excellence across the PKI environment.
- Architecture & Deployment: Refine technical requirements, design and document system architecture updates, execute testing, and oversee technical deployments.
- Operations & Continuity: Manage Disaster Recovery (DR) rehearsal tasks, monitor operational KPIs, and drive continuous performance improvements during run-phase operations.
- Lifecycle Support: Provide hands-on operational support for certificate lifecycle management and perform data management.

Requirements:

Our placements are open to Undergraduates only. Therefore it is mandatory for candidates to be an undergraduate for the whole duration of the placement. Please inform your graduation date on your application.

*Your application should include a CV along with a Cover Letter outlining your motivation and suitability for the role.*

Successful candidates will demonstrate the following:
- Studying towards a bachelor’s degree in Information Technology or Cybersecurity;
- Familiarity with IT applications, and their infrastructures (Servers, web servers, operating systems and databases);
- Foundation of General IT principles (architecture designs and standards, networks, cyber security).
- Practical knowledge of project management fundamentals and operational methods;
- You take an analytical and proactive approach to solving complex technical challenges;
- You communicate clearly and bring a strong team-first attitude to daily collaboration.

SECURITY CLEARANCE: You will be subject to a BPSS (Baseline Personnel Security Standard) check. You may also need to gain UK SC-level Security Clearance or Export Control, depending on the role.

postings.title: Data Compliance Operations Specialist
postings.description:
Job Description:
Responsibilities - your mission

As a member of the Data Security and Compliance team, your primary objective is to mitigate data loss risks and enhance Airbus's alignment with corporate data management policies and regulations (including Export Control, Data Privacy, National Security, and Company Classified Data).

Core activities: Controlled Data Operations
My Data Compliance (Airbus Applications’ Classification and Compliance referential)

You are the privileged interface between regulations / company policies and Application Managers / Business Owners to whom you provide guidance and support in documenting required application details and compliance related information (e.g: ecosystem, scope, users, technical configuration, security measures,...) in order to establish and maintain precise Classification and determine Compliance Levels for all Applications within Airbus Aircraft perimeter.

Cookie Consent Compliance management
Your role involves collaborating with Legal and Web factory teams to ensure that Airbus-owned websites adhere to industry-leading cookie management standards and guarantee these platforms remain fully compliant with external regulatory requirements and internal privacy policies (i.e: GDPR). Proficiency in the use of OneTrust for Consent Management, this includes basic technical knowledge of OneTrust scripts.

Extended activities: Data Compliance Center
- You will contribute to DCC activities when required through:
- Support to the team on non-compliance remediation campaigns.
- Creation / Update / Maintenance of specific dashboards and reports including data compliance controls effectiveness monitoring.
- Alerts management (data analysis, response, false positive identification,...)
- Help on development processes: new use-cases entry into service, testing support, reports review…

Requirements - our ideal candidate will have

Skills & Competencies
- A Bachelor or Master degree related to IT, Data Science, Engineering, Business management.
- Regulatory Foundations: Solid understanding of the different Data regulations such as: Export Control, Data Privacy (e.g: GDPR), National Security, and specific Company Classification.
- Information Technology & Cybersecurity: Proficiency in addressing topics related to IT and cybersecurity, including related risk management activities.
- Dashboarding & Analytics: Ability to manage data (preparation, cleaning and analysis) as well as maintaining and updating BI dashboarding tools like Looker Studio and Qlik.
- Effective Communication: Strong communication skills (English mandatory) with an ability to explain the "Why" behind complex compliance rules to non-expert users.

Personality and Attitude
- Problem Solving & Analytical mindset: Highly detail-oriented with a strong analytical mindset and excellent problem-solving skills.
- Autonomy & Resilience: Excellent organizational skills and resilience to manage end-to-end security and compliance activities autonomously.
- Customer centric: Maintaining a strong focus on customers and stakeholders, with the professionalism required to mentor and assist them through complex requirements, even when compliance is outside their primary area of knowledge or priority.
- Team player: With the right motivation to play a key role in a dynamic team, able to explore ways to improve collaboration and support others in reaching common goals.
- Continuous improvement and Growth: Driven to continuously elevate our services, expand our own skills, and champion knowledge-sharing across the team.
- Uncompromised Integrity: A strong commitment to compliance and integrity as the foundation for safeguarding the company’s reputation and sustainable growth.

Benefits - what’s in it for you
- Diverse career opportunities within Airbus European core countries or in other regions around the world

- A hybrid working model, allowing you to combine onsite and offsite work

- A modern office at Parque das Nacoes, well connected to public transportation

- A motivated and fun crew to grow and build and shape the GBS together

- An intense and exciting onboarding experience

postings.title: Data Handling System Engineer (d/m/w)
postings.description:
Job Description:
Zur Unterstützung der Abteilung " DHS/ Comms HW & Architects" sucht Airbus Defence and Space einen Data Handling System Engineer (d/m/w).

Du wirst Teil unserer transnationalen Abteilung, die die zentrale On-Board Computer und Massenspeicher der Raumfahrzeuge entwickelt. Wir verantworten das Data Handling System (DHS) für prestigeträchtige Missionen in den Bereichen Erdbeobachtung, Wissenschaft, Exploration sowie Telekommunikation und Navigation. Als Architekt bist du die zentrale technische Instanz, die elektrische Hardware, Software und komplexe Protokolle zu einem funktionierenden Gesamtsystem zusammenführt.

Diese Stelle ist auch mit reduzierter Wochenarbeitszeit und angepasstem Aufgabenbereich möglich.

Dein Standort
Am Airbus-Standort in Immenstaad am Bodensee arbeitest du dort, wo die Zukunft von Connected Intelligence, Space und Air Power entsteht. In einer Umgebung, die Weitblick bietet, gestaltest du technologische Innovationen über Domänen hinweg.
Unser Standort lebt vom Dialog: Auf dem Campus triffst du auf ein einzigartiges Netzwerk aus Experten für Satellitentechnik, militärische Luftfahrt, Cyber-Security, Künstliche Intelligenz sowie Combat Cloud und Ground Support von morgen. Auch unsere Zusammenarbeit ist geprägt von Dynamik – in agilen Teams widmen wir uns den komplexesten Fragestellungen, von KI-gestützter Erdbeobachtung bis zur sicheren Cloud-Architektur. Wer technologische Exzellenz und interdisziplinäre Zusammenarbeit sucht, findet hier das ideale Umfeld.

Unsere Benefits für dich
- Faire Vergütung & Extras: Attraktive Vergütung und individuelle Zusatzleistungen, z. B. betriebliche Vorsorgemodelle, Mobilitätsangebote (bspw. Fahrradleasing) oder Mitarbeitervorteile bei kooperierenden Unternehmen gemäß unseren jeweils gültigen Richtlinien.

- Zeit für dich (und deine Angehörigen): 30 Tage Jahresurlaub gem. Tarifvertrag (35h/Woche); Vereinbarkeit von Familie & Beruf (Gleitzeit, mobiles Arbeiten, Teilzeit, Jobsharing, Sabbatical)

- Weiterkommen leicht gemacht: Ausgezeichnete Weiterbildungsmöglichkeiten und internationale, konzernweite Entwicklungsperspektiven

- Wohlfühlen am Arbeitsplatz: Betriebsarzt; umfassendes Gesundheitsangebot (Sportkurse, Präventionsangebote, uvm.), Kantine und Cafeteria, Kindertagesstätte am Standort

- Vielfalt verbindet: Arbeiten in einem diversen Umfeld, mit mehr als 140 Nationalitäten, in dem Austausch, Unterstützung und Vielfalt gelebt wird

Deine Aufgaben und Verantwortlichkeiten
- Technische Schnittstelle & Architektur: Du fungierst als primärer Ansprechpartner für den Chief Engineer, Kunden, Zulieferer und andere Fachbereiche (Software, Payload, Electrical, Mechanik, Thermal) für alle On-Board Data Handling (OBDH) Subsystem-Themen.

- Design & Anforderungsmanagement: Du führst Trade-off-Studien durch und definierst die Hardware-Architektur des Data Handling Systems, inklusive Datenraten, Prozessorgeschwindigkeiten und elektrischen Schnittstellen.

- Supplier Management: Du erstellst Spezifikationen für DH-Equipment, unterstützt die Fertigung beim Lieferanten (Co-Engineering) und leitest Design-Boards sowie Acceptance-Reviews.

- Schnittstellen-Kompatibilität: Du definierst die Datenflüsse zwischen Plattform und Payload (Massenspeicher, Kryptoeinheiten) sowie das Housekeeping (TM/TC) und erstellst/verwaltest die entsprechenden Budgets (Bus Traffic, CPU-Last).

- Verifikation & Launch: Du erstellst Testspezifikationen, unterstützt das AIT-Team bei der Systemintegration und begleitest die Launch- sowie In-Orbit-Testaktivitäten direkt vor Ort oder remote.

- Subsystem Management: Du managst das Subsystem eigenverantwortlich für eine OTOCOQ Lieferung, Integration & Verifikation. Du unterstützt das Satellitenprojekt in kommerziellen Belangen durch deine technische Expertise und bei der Zeit- und Kostenplanung

Erforderliche Kenntnisse und Qualifikationen
- Abgeschlossenes Studium im Bereich Elektrotechnik, Luft- und Raumfahrttechnik oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation.

- Fundierte Erfahrung in der Architektur von Data Handling Hardware-Subsystemen.

- Tiefgehende Kenntnisse gängiger Weltraum-Standards (z. B. ECSS, CCSDS).

- Langjährige Berufserfahrung im Bereich Data Handling oder komplexer eingebetteter Systeme.

- Verhandlungssichere Englischkenntnisse; Deutschkenntnisse sind ein klarer Vorteil für die Arbeit am Standort.

postings.title: Datalink Systems Test Engineer (h/f)
postings.description:
Job Description:
A vacancy for a DataLink Systems Test Engineer (m/f) has arisen within Airbus Commercial Aircraft in Toulouse. You will join a team composed of 20 persons within the Airbus Flight and Integration Tests center. This team is in charge of providing maturity statements of NAVIGATION, SURVEILLANCE and COMMUNICATION systems, following integration tests performed through Benches or Simulators, and Post Test Flights analysis.

Our team vision is to define experiment and industrialize future methods and means to perform those tests, in line with company objectives:
- Contribute to the Autonomy Research & Technology Roadmap for Single Pilot Operation

- Develop New Tests solutions based on new technologies (e.g. Artificial Intelligence..) for testing the next aircraft generation (zero Emission, Single Pilot, Visual Based Landing…)

- Decrease Aircraft Development timeframe while increase systems maturity before their deliveries to our customers

AIR-GROUND COMMUNICATION is a wide range of avionics systems such as HF and VHF radios, Satellite communications (SATCOM), Wireless (Cellular 3G/4G/5G, Wifi, Lifi..), Cockpit AUDIO systems, DATALINK systems and functions.

Powered by an experienced team and a business driven pioneer spirit, the Tests Centre gathers all engineering testing skills:
- From the definition of the testing strategies

- Lab test means design and validation (test rigs and aircraft simulators)

- Lab test means and real aircrafts instrumentation

- System integration in laboratory with real A/C equipments

- Up to flight tests campaigns on the A320, A330, A350, A380 and A400M Airbus development aircrafts.

The Tests Centre is a transnational Center of Competence with teams in Filton, Hamburg, Bremen, Toulouse and Bangalore.
Inside the Tests Centre, you will join the department specialized in integration of many avionics systems such as Air Traffic Management (ATM) systems, Communications, Navigation and Surveillance systems, Flight Management System, Cockpit Displays and Flight Warning systems, Maintenance and Flight Operations systems as well as cyber and physical security.

The Datalink function is in charge of ensuring exchange of messages between the aircraft and the Air Traffic Control or between the aircraft and the airline. It is based on a router which interact with various onboard applications and communication means for Air/ground data exchanges. Therefore it involves many systems and communication protocols such as ACARS (Aircraft Communication Addressing and Reporting System), ATN (Aeronautical Traffic Network), Arinc 429 and Arinc 619.

Tasks & accountabilities

Your main tasks and responsibilities will include:
- Defining testing strategy (Lab and Flight)

- Defining and development follow up of test means and tools and required instrumentation

- Designing test procedures including automatic testing and/or virtual testing when appropriate

- Executing test campaigns on Lab test rigs and A/C Simulators

- Defining flight test campaigns procedures with flight crew and analyse flight test results

- Participating to the development and maturity of latest innovative Datalink aspects driven for AIRBUS future cockpit policies such as introduction of ATN over SATCOM or IP based communications for safety services (ATN/IPS).

This activities include close interactions with many stakeholders:
- Avionics systems testers: FANS, FMS, CMS, ACMS, AOC, FOMAX…

- Communication means testers: VHF, SATCOM, HF

- Supplier, Design Office and Flight test crew

- Datalink service providers: SITA, ARINC

This role will involve some travel for business and as such you must be able to travel accordingly.

You will have the following skills and experience:
- Educated to master degree level (or equivalent) in Systems, Telecommunication or a related discipline

- Strong interest for Technical activities

- Open minded & agile

- IT & Network knowledge would be a plus

- Advanced level of English.

postings.title: Developer - Fullstack (REACT/Java/Python)
postings.description:
Job Description:
Description of the job

Airbus India is looking for a senior Full-Stack Developer to join our team in Bengaluru. You will join the Airline Sciences team within the Digital department.

Join our Product team that will design and build specialized products, utilizing the core capabilities of our simulation/data models. This role is like that of a Solutions Engineer to solve real-world aerospace challenges through rapid digital innovation. Acting as the Product Manager’s technical co-pilot, you will be involved in scoping business needs, build interactive prototypes, and deliver scalable web solutions integrated with the core simulation models and data pipelines.
This role offers end to end development accountability, combining airline operations problem-solving with hands-on full-stack development.

As a software developer, you will be responsible for developing and implementing frontend/backend components using ReactJS, NodeJS, Java, Spring Boot concepts on Microservices. Also, there may be a need to create an application prototype using Python, as part of a Proof-Of-concept.
You will also be responsible for the database, AWS Cloud and DevOps tasks specific to the product delivery aligned to you.

This position will report to a Senior Group Manager/Product Manager within Airbus India. Passion for technology and problem solving are a must have.

Domain: Commercial flight operations, flight navigation, flight data monitoring (FDM/FOQA), ACARS/ADS-B telemetry feeds, airport operations (AODB), fuel optimization, and disruption management.

Tech Stack: Modern frontend frameworks (React), backend services in Python (FastAPI, Django) and/or Node.js/TypeScript, RESTful and GraphQL APIs, Docker, and Cloud platforms (AWS).

Architecture: Microservices, event-driven data ingestion, caching strategies (Redis), and responsive data dashboards.

Please note: This is a modern web application and cloud data engineering role. It is not an embedded systems, avionics firmware, or DO-178C certification position.

Tasks & accountabilities

Your main tasks and responsibilities will include:

The work itself
- Write clean, maintainable, and production-ready code alongside the Lead Developer and Full-Stack Developers.
- Implement backend business logic that encodes complex aeronautical and aircraft operational calculations into software services.
- Participate in sprint planning, code reviews, deployment pipeline configuration (CI/CD), and tier-2 operational troubleshooting for live applications.
- Collaborates with other developers and provides significant contributions to develop specifications, to resolve business client questions, problems solving, bug fixing, testing, and investigating platform issues.
- Participates in all phases of product development lifecycle, from the analysis, design over test and integration to operation of products.
- Researches, evaluates, and develops new tools to improve product development efficiency.
- Deploys, tests and/or integrates highly available, scalable, maintainable, monitored systems and services.
- May assist in development of product user manuals.
- Coordinates the functional and technical integration.
- Defines the test strategy, scripts, scenarios and monitors test execution.
- Determines how existing applications, legacy systems, databases, web interfaces and/or hardware logic, which may be currently operating on multiple platforms, work together to meet the new and emerging enterprise requirements.

With proven capabilities, you may also be involved in:
- Support the Lead Developer in being a technical bridge between specialized applications and centralized core capabilities.
- Architect secure, scalable microservices and API gateways to ingest, process, and display aerospace data.
- Ensure all bespoke solutions comply with global cloud architecture, cyber security, and data governance standards.
- Potential partnership with the Product Manager/Lead during client discovery workshops to assess business needs
- Evaluate customer IT ecosystems, data feeds, and API capabilities to define technical feasibility and architecture blueprints
- Rapidly build interactive prototypes, data flows, and build APIs to demonstrate feasibility and secure stakeholder buy-in

This role may involve some travel for business in Europe and as such you must be able to travel accordingly.

Required skills

We are looking for candidates with the following skills and experience:

The skills you bring
- Bachelor or Master degree in Aeronautical Engineering, Computer Science, Software Engineering or other related discipline preferred
- 5-7 years of experience in Software Development and especially working hands-on in a fast-paced discovery to design to prototype and industrialize specialized applications, predominantly in the Aerospace/Airline Operations scope
- Knowledge / hands-on experience in handling aviation data and digital application needs (real-life aviation/airline operations products, possibly simulation platforms) is mandatory
- Hands-on experience with frontend development of UI components for ADT applications using ReactJS / Redux technologies
- Experience in Python coding
- Java development (including experience with JDK 8+ preferred) and a strong experience using Spring Framework
- Experience developing multithreaded application in Java to build high performing applications
- Expertize in memory management while doing application design and development and experience of building scalable applications
- Experience in following an agile methodology (SCRUM, KABAN)
- Knowledge of all phases of software development including design, coding, testing, debugging, implementation, and support
- Knowledge and strong experience with GIT
- Ability to thoroughly understand the business issues surrounding each project
- Knowledge and experience in at least one of the following technologies: MySQL, Maven, Spring Framework, Jenkins, JIRA
- Direct interaction with business teams for requirement analysis, issue troubleshooting and resolution, first line support to the users for their business needs.
- Familiarity with version control systems and CI/CD pipelines.
- Good knowledge on designing and implementing APIs, RESTful web-services and SOAP-based Web-services
- Knowledge of AWS Cloud and Microservices architecture
- English: advanced level both verbal and written

Along with the above mandatory skillsets, highly preferable candidates will showcase:
- Experience with client discovery workshops to understand airline operational bottlenecks and solution scoping
AND/OR
- Experience with digital product development within the aerospace / aviation domain
AND/OR
- Hands-on experience with aerospace/aviation data and its usage
AND
- Demonstrated experience integrating AI coding assistants and modern productivity tools into the end-to-end software development lifecycle (ideation, development, automated test generation, and code review).

Success Metrics:
Success will be measured in a variety of areas, including but not limited to
- Deliver business value as defined by product owner and accountable for team’s delivery value as well
- Give a transparent information during the AGILE rituals (Remaining to do and issues encountered) and request help for support
- Consistently ensure the on-time delivery and quality (first-time-right) of the sprints
- Bring innovative cost effective solutions
- Achieve customer satisfaction
- Ability to handle a subject from demand management, to development and support
- Ability to challenge the needs of the clients and provide appropriate solutions

The role will have the following key outputs:
- Strong link with the Airbus Digital organization
- Good quality code and participation in improvement of existing code
- Proactive in providing guidance & inputs for the product’s roadmap

Job Description:
Airbus Aerosystems Kinston is looking for a Digital Finance Product Manager to join our team based in Kinston, NC

This is a critical digital role within our newly established Digital team in Kinston, instrumental in ensuring end to end stability and performance of our Digital Finance Solution with a primary focus on ERP (SAP) solution. You'll be the on-site digital representative for the digital finance solutions providing a vital link between our local Kinston site and the central ERP Centre of Excellence (CoE) for all these subjects.

Initially, you will be the Digital Finance leader to ensure the deployment of our digital finance solutions (local & central) to the Kinston site and facilitate the move to the end state finalizing the transition to Airbus. This means looking beyond the immediate transition, understanding the bigger picture, being familiar with the strategy and the different digital finance solutions, and supporting decisions that align with our long-term objectives. Beyond this, you'll play a crucial role to ensure overall consistency and ensure the Digital Finance solutions are maintained by anticipating evolutions needed.

In the meantime, this role will support the creation and stabilization of a small Digital Finance team in the North America Region in order to be able to face current and future challenges.

This position offers a unique opportunity to play a key role for Digital Finance in North America, supporting immediate key projects and activities, and contributing strategically to the success of our manufacturing ramp-up in a dynamic environment undergoing significant transformation in the North America Region.

.Meet the Team:
Our team at Airbus Aerosystems Kinston manufactures crucial aircraft components. On the shop floor you’ll be surrounded by individuals who are passionate about aviation and skilled in areas like electrical, structure and quality. Join our team and help build the next generation of aircraft.

Your Working Environment:
The Airbus Aerosystems Kinston facility sits at the forefront of aerospace manufacturing, specializing in the production of large, advanced composite aerostructures. Our team builds critical components for the state-of-the-art Airbus A350 XWB, including the composite center fuselage and wing spar.

How We Care for You:
- Financial Rewards: Competitive pay, incentive compensation which may include profit sharing schemes, retirement savings plan and the ability to participate in an Employee Stock Ownership Plan (“ESOP”)
- Work/Life Balance: Paid time off including personal time, holidays and a paid parental leave program.
- Health & Welfare: Comprehensive insurance coverage including medical, prescription, dental, vision, life, disability, Employee Assistance Plan (“EAP”) and other supplemental benefit coverages.
- Individual Development: Upskilling and development opportunities through our global Leadership University, including unlimited access to 10,000+ e-learning courses focusing on ways to develop your employability, certifications, career path; as well as the opportunity to participate in accelerated development programmes; and both national and international mobility.

Your Challenges:

Manage and lead the transition period from an overall Digital Finance perspective: 40%
- Ensure services delivered from existing suppliers are in line with the current contracts to secure the day to day activities. (bugs / defects resolution as per TSA) until the transition to the end state is secured.

- Anticipate, Advice & Secure on potential mandatory small evolutions / change requests of the As-Is solutions with the existing suppliers being and remaining compliant / efficient.

- Develop deep understanding of the As-Is solutions (end to end) with processes associated to ease the transition to the Digital Finance central and local solutions.

- Be the focal point between Kinston local teams and the central SAP ERP CoE (Finance), ensuring effective communication and alignment on Finance solutions.
