postings.description:
Job Description:
DIGITAL SECURITY MANAGEMENT

The Digital Security Manager is responsible for overseeing and driving digital security operations for Airbus and all its divisions and affiliates in China, including the Commercial Aircraft, Defence & Space, and Helicopters divisions divisions.
The job holder is responsible for overseeing and driving digital security operations across China, encompassing:
- Implementation of the corporate digital security strategy within business operations

- Industrial digital security activities

- Digital security risk identification and mitigation

- Support for digital security audits, technical evaluations, and compliance frameworks

- Support for the HR secure hiring process

- Contributions to threat intelligence

- On-demand support for technical legal investigations

- Data Leakage Prevention (DLP) management

- Support to digital security training and awareness programs

- Support security evaluations during the procurement call for tender (CFT) selection process

Main activities
Strategic activities
- Support the Chief Information Security Officer (CISO) in deploying corporate digital security initiatives

- Coordinate and facilitate local digital security initiatives and programs across China

- Identify, consolidate, and manage digital security risks and their corresponding response plans in China

- Assist the CISO in drafting, validating, and publishing digital security policies, processes, and position papers

Client-related activities
- Interface directly with local business units on digital security topics

- Liaise closely with the IM Cybersecurity team regarding operational controls and initiatives

Operational activities
- Ensure absolute compliance with Corporate and Divisional digital security requirements and standards

- Provide dedicated security support for products, services, and ongoing projects

- Provide guidance, formal responses, and validation for digital security requests and queries

- Contribute to security awareness by designing, organizing, and delivering educational materials and training sessions

- Manage digital risks through comprehensive identification, assessment, reporting, and remediation follow-ups

- Ensure thorough vulnerability management and follow-up across all corporate IT and Operational Technology (OT) assets

- Support technical legal investigations and forensic laboratory activities on-demand

- Coordinate and support technical digital security technical evaluations

- Coordinate and support audits and regulatory compliance initiatives (e.g., ISO27001, PART-IS, etc.)

- Implement localized digital security projects and strategic initiatives

- Scout new and emerging technologies that enhance the digital security posture

- Support on-demand security screening of candidates, including establishing, formalizing, and maintaining comprehensive screening processes, tools, and methodologies

- Contribute to and proactively anticipate threat intelligence

- Continuously improve the precision and response capabilities of Data Leakage Prevention (DLP) information

- Evaluate vendor security postures within procurement processes to support business selection

- Execute other tasks as assigned by the CISO

Outputs
Financial Outputs
N/A

Client-related Outputs
- Ensure that all business activities remain fully compliant with corporate security policies and standards

- Supervision of IM cybersecurity operational compliance KPIs to ensure they consistently meet targets

Operational Outputs
- Achievement of yearly operational objectives

- Delivery of high-quality, timely security support to the business

- Maintenance of an accurate digital security risk exposure map and corresponding action plans

- On-demand technical support for specific legal investigations

- Timely completion and follow-up of technical evaluations

- High-quality, timely execution of candidate screening

- Precise and responsive DLP detection and mitigation

- Rigorous security assessments for the CFT process

Skills & Experience
Education & Professional Qualifications
- Academic Background: Bachelor's or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Cybersecurity, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field

- Certifications: possessing professional certifications or framework-specific certifications (e.g., ISO 27001) are a strong plus

Knowledge & Experience
- Cybersecurity Operations: experience in digital security, risk management, or cybersecurity operations

- Regulatory & Compliance: Comprehensive understanding of Chinese cybersecurity laws and regulations. Familiarity with aviation standards like PART-IS.

- IT/OT Environment: experience securing both standard Information Technology (IT) and Operational Technology (OT) / Industrial Control Systems (ICS) environments

Skills & Competencies
- Technical & Operational Skills: Risk Management, Incident Response, Forensics, Vulnerability Management, DLP, IT/OT Security

- Soft Skills & Leadership: Stakeholder Management, Cross-Functional Collaboration, Risk Communication, Analytical Mindset, Discretion & Confidentiality

- Languages: Full professional proficiency in both English and Mandarin (mandatory for global and local stakeholder interfacing)

postings.description:
Job Description:
Von der Cloud, über KI-unterstützte medizinische Geräte oder Augmented Reality: Die Informatik ist in unserem Alltag heute fest und überall verankert. Durch die hohe Dynamik der Technologie entstehen immer neue Chancen und Herausforderungen in der Informatik.

Im dualen Studium Informatik befasst du dich mit der systematischen Analyse, Gestaltung, Implementierung und Pflege von Softwaresystemen, die auf eine lange Lebenszeit angelegt sind. Du erlernst Programmiersprachen, Algorithmen und Datenstrukturen, um effiziente Lösungen für komplexe Probleme zu entwickeln.

Im Studienschwerpunkt “IT Security” werden die folgenden Themenfelder behandelt: IT-Recht, IT Security, Design sicherer Systeme, Sichere Produktionssysteme, Data Security, Cloud Computing, Funknetze, Netzarchitekturen, Sichere Unternehmensnetze, Angriffsmethoden, Penetration Testing, Angewandte Informatikforschung.
Dein Standort

Zwischen Stuttgart und München gelegen, ist Ulm eine Stadt, die ein breites Spektrum an Freizeit- und Kulturangeboten bietet. Hier kannst du die Lebensqualität unter dem höchsten Kirchturm der Welt genießen und Teil einer Stadt sein, die sowohl ihre historischen Sehenswürdigkeiten bewahrt, als auch die Zukunft entlang der Donau aktiv gestaltet.

Während deines Studiums hast du die Chance, (min.) zwei unserer Airbus-Standorte kennen zu lernen: In unseren Ausbildungslaboren am Standort Friedrichshafen hast du die Möglichkeit eine breite Basis an Wissen zu erlangen. Unser Portfolio reicht in der Informatik von der klassischen Desktop Entwicklung bis hin zur Roboterarm-Programmierung, sowie in der Elektrotechnik bis hin zur Entwicklung und Fertigung eigener elektronischer Platinen. Unsere mechatronische Lehrwerkstatt rundet unser Angebot ab. Ergänzend dazu bieten wir eine individuelles Studium, bei der du Schlüssel- und Zusatzqualifikationen in Kompetenztagen oder bei den verschiedensten Projekten erlangen kannst. Durch kleine Teams wirst du persönlich gefördert und kannst dich stetig unter Beweis stellen.

(A)SLC am Standort Ulm bietet eine umfassende Palette an Funk- und IT-Lösungen für mobile, taktische Kommunikation an. Wir sind stolz darauf, mit über 300 Funknetzen in mehr als 80 Ländern einer der führenden Anbieter im Bereich professioneller Mobilfunk zu sein. Damit leistet die ASLC einen wesentlichen Beitrag zur Stabilisierung der weltweiten Sicherheit. Knapp 1.150 Mitarbeitende in 17 Ländern realisieren die Planung, den Aufbau und den Betrieb unserer Mobilfunknetze. Die Verfügbarkeit und Zuverlässigkeit unserer Netze ist dabei Industrie-Benchmark.

Als eigenständige Einheit der Secure Land Communications (Teil der Airbus-Gruppe) ist die ASLC GmbH für Kunden im deutschsprachigen Raum verantwortlich. Schwerpunkt der Geschäftstätigkeit bildet die Ausstattung unserer Kunden mit maßgeschneiderten Lösungen in den Bereichen Sicherheit, Verteidigung, Transport, Versorgung und Industrie. Dies umfasst die Realisierung von landesweiten Sicherheitsfunknetzen, wie beispielsweise dem digitalen Behördenfunk der Bundesrepublik in Deutschland. Am Sitz in Ulm sowie an den weiteren Standorten in Sulzbach (Taunus) und in Berlin arbeiten rund 240 Mitarbeitende zum Beispiel im Solution Management, im Customer Support Engineering oder im Projektmanagement tagtäglich an der Planung, Realisierung oder im Service von innovativen Kundenlösungen.
Wecken Stichworte wie IT, Cyber Security, IoT, LTE, 5G, TETRA, Network Management oder Automated Testing Deine Neugierde? Dann sind bist Du bei uns genau richtig!

Den ersten Teil deines Studiums verbringst du an unserem Standort in Friedrichshafen. In nur 15-20 Minuten pendelst du zwischen Airbus und der Hochschule mit dem Fahrrad. Im 2. Theoriesemesters des Studiums wechselst du in deinen Fachbericht nach Ulm. Du bekommst ebenfall die Möglichkeit, den Standorte in Sulzbach kennen zu lernen.

Das bieten wir dir
- Attraktive Ausbildungsvergütung, sowie tarifliche Sonderzahlungen wie Urlaubs- und Weihnachtsgeld

- Übernahme der Studiengebühren und weitere finanzielle Unterstützungen (z.B. Wohngeldzuschuss, Busfahrkarte, Kantinenzuschuss, ...)

- verschiedene Firmen-Benefits (z.B. Altersvorsorge, Berufsunfähigkeit, Aktienprogramm,...)

- Mobiles Arbeiten und flexible Arbeitszeiten (Gleitzeit)

- Sozialpädagogische Seminare und fachliche Weiterbildungen

- Abwechslungsreiche Ausbildungseinsätze in spannenden Fachbereichen

- Weiterqualifizierung während und nach der Ausbildung

- Auslandsaufenthalte ( bspw. Frankreich, Spanien, Irland, etc.)

- Projekt- und Kompetenzwochen

Das solltest du mitbringen
- Allgemeine Hochschulreife (Abitur) oder Fachhochschulreife

- Hohes Interesse an Qualitätsmanagement und -prozessen

- Interesse an naturwissenschaftlichen Fächern, insbesondere Physik und Mathematik

- Verständnis für technische Zusammenhänge sowie sicherer Umgang mit Computern und moderner Software

- Mobilität und Flexibilität, da die Ausbildung an mehreren Ausbildungsstätten stattfindet

Information zur Hochschule

postings.title: Duales Studium B.Sc. Informatik - IT-Security (d/m/w) zum 01.09.2027
postings.description:
Job Description:
Duales Studium B.Sc. Informatik - IT-Security (d/m/w) zum 01.09.2027

Starte deine Karriere bei Airbus!
Bist du fasziniert davon, wie Technologie die Geschäftswelt verändert, und möchtest aktiv die Zukunft mitgestalten? Dann ist ein Duales Studium bei Airbus genau das Richtige für dich!

Ob die Absicherung sensibler Unternehmensdaten oder die Verteidigung gegen Cyberangriffe – die digitale Transformation ist aus unserem Alltag und der Wirtschaft nicht mehr wegzudenken. Diese rasante Entwicklung schafft ständig neue Chancen und Herausforderungen, besonders im Bereich der IT-Sicherheit.

Im Dualen Studium Informatik – IT-Security lernst du, wie man Unternehmen vor digitalen Bedrohungen schützt und sichere IT-Infrastrukturen aufbaut. Du wirst darauf vorbereitet, Schwachstellen zu erkennen, Schutzmaßnahmen zu implementieren und auf Sicherheitsvorfälle zu reagieren. Deine Aufgabe wird es sein, Anforderungen an die IT-Sicherheit zu definieren und deren Umsetzung zu begleiten.

Du lernst, wie man Sicherheitsprozesse plant, realisiert und optimiert und wie man in diesem dynamischen Umfeld neue Schutzmechanismen entwickelt. Dabei tauchst du tief in Themenfelder wie Netzwerksicherheit, Kryptographie, Schwachstellenanalyse, Incident Response, Cloud Security und die Grundlagen von Cyberkriminalität ein. So bist du bestens vorbereitet, um die digitale Zukunft von Airbus sicher mitzugestalten!

Dein Standort: Airbus Ottobrunn – Wo deine Ideen fliegen!
Stell dir vor: Du bist mitten in Ottobrunn, nur einen Katzensprung von München entfernt, und arbeitest an Technologien, die die Welt verändern. Bei Airbus gestaltest du die Zukunft der Luft- und Raumfahrt – und das in einem mega coolen Umfeld! Nach der Arbeit noch Energie? Kein Problem! Ob beim Sport, gemeinsame Zeit mit Freunden verbringen oder einfach nur das bunte Stadtleben von München genießen – hier findest du immer den perfekten Ausgleich.

In Ottobrunn sind wir echte Experten, wenn es um High-Tech-Lösungen geht. Wir entwickeln zum Beispiel:
- Antriebe für Raketen und Satelliten, die ins All fliegen!

- Sensoren, die kleinste Details erkennen – egal ob in der Luft oder im Weltraum.

- Kommunikationssysteme, die dafür sorgen, dass Piloten und Bodenpersonal immer verbunden sind.

- Systeme zur Aufklärung und Überwachung, die uns helfen, die Welt sicherer zu machen.

Kurz gesagt: Bei uns lernst du nicht nur einen Beruf, sondern bist Teil von etwas Großem. Du bist dabei, wenn wir die Technologien von morgen entwickeln – und das direkt vor den Toren Münchens!

Dein Studienstandort in Friedrichshafen
Deine Theoriephasen absolvierst du an der DHBW Ravensburg am Campus Technik in Friedrichshafen.

Was dich bei uns erwartet
Bei Airbus erwartet dich ein Duales Studium, das dich optimal auf deine Zukunft vorbereitet:
- Dich erwartet eine praxisnahe Ausbildung in modernen Abteilungen, wo du wichtiges Fachwissen direkt anwenden und vertiefen kannst.

- Wir ergänzen deine Lernphasen mit individuellen Projekten und Trainings, die dir helfen, überfachliche Kompetenzen und Schlüsselqualifikationen aufzubauen.

- Durch die Arbeit in kleinen Teams und eine persönliche Betreuung kannst du dich stetig weiterentwickeln und deine Talente optimal einsetzen.

Werde Teil unserer AIRzubi Community
Bei Airbus bist du nicht allein – du wirst Teil einer großen, starken Community. Wir glauben daran, dass wir gemeinsam am besten sind. Deshalb fördern wir den Austausch untereinander, sei es in Projektteams, bei gemeinsamen Events oder in unseren vielfältigen Sport- und Freizeitgruppen. Du findest schnell Anschluss, knüpfst wichtige Kontakte und erlebst einen starken Zusammenhalt, der dich durch dein Studium begleitet.

Deine Vorteile auf einen Blick
Bei Airbus ist uns wichtig, dass du dich wohlfühlst und bestens unterstützt wirst. Deshalb bieten wir dir:

postings.title: Ensia - IT Operations Specialist Spain
postings.description:
Job Description:
Job Summary:
- Contract: Unlimited

- Start Date: As soon as possible.

- Location: Getafe.

- Compensation: Based on profile and/or experience + Ensia employee benefits.

- Reports to: Head of Digital Operations

- You must attach your resume in English

Context:
The IT Operations Specialist for Spain is a key role within our global IT structure. You will be the primary focal point for all Testia sites in Spain, while also being an integral part of a transnational team. This team collaborates closely to share best practices and ensure consistent service delivery across the group.
Simultaneously, you will act as the crucial link between Spanish business needs and our central transnational IT teams (Infrastructure, Applications, and Security). Your scope will cover all internal Testia IT needs while also supporting seamless cooperation with, and on, external customer systems. You will ensure global IT strategies are successfully implemented locally and that local requirements are effectively communicated to the global team. This position requires a blend of hands-on technical support, local site management, customer oriented mindset and strategic collaboration.

Job Responsibilities and Objectives:
Local IT Operations
- Be the primary IT contact for all national sites, building strong relationships with local management and end-users

- Manage the complete lifecycle of local IT assets, including procurement, deployment, inventory management, maintenance, and disposal (end-user and network devices)

- Key-Contact for end-users in case of IT-Issues

- Provide on-site support with a focus on Level 2 & 3 Support

- Oversee the IT onboarding and offboarding process for new employees

- With the help of IT subcontractors and the transnational IT team, guarantee the maintenance in operational conditions of our physical installations (routers, switches, servers, etc.)

- Act as the "smart hands" and on-site representative for the central Infrastructure team, assisting with network equipment, servers, and other hardware maintenance

- Manage local IT vendors, procurement, service contracts and budget (e.g., local ISP, mobile phone providers, printer provider)

Transnational Alignment & Collaboration
- Collaborate closely with the transnational Heads of Infrastructure, Applications, and Cybersecurity to ensure global IT standards and policies are effectively implemented and maintained within the national framework

- Deploy global IT initiatives and digital transformation projects within the national perimeter

- Actively participate in the global IT team, aligning with other operations specialists (Germany, Spain, UK, etc.) to share best practices, provide mutual support, and ensure consistent service delivery. This may include providing remote support to other countries as needed

- Support the Cyber Security / ISMS Officer by enforcing security policies locally and assisting in any local security incident response

IT Customer Operations
- Act as the key IT Partner for the Managing Director and local business leaders, ensuring IT services are aligned with their operational needs

- Gather and communicate local business requirements to the central IT team to inform future strategy and solutions

- Administer user accounts for specific customer systems (e.g., Airbus) as required, directly exchange with customer IT-counterparts

What We're Looking For
2/3 years' higher education in IT or systems and network administration, or a Master's degree or engineering school.
You will have initial experience of IT and networks in a Windows and Linux environment and/or personal or professional experience of development/scripting in modern languages.

Technical IT skills:
- Active Directory

- Windows administration

- Solid understanding of networking fundamentals (TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, VLANs, Wi-Fi)

- Experience with IT Service Management (ITSM) principles and ticketing software

- Proficiency with client-side VPN technologies (e.g., Cisco AnyConnect)

- Knowledge of databases and their administration

- Knowledge of web languages (e.g. PHP, JavaScript, Python, etc.) and scripts

Soft Skills:
- Excellent communication, interpersonal, and stakeholder management skills.

- A strong customer-service mindset and proactive, "can-do" attitude.

- Proven ability to work autonomously, manage priorities, and solve problems effectively.

- A collaborative team player, comfortable working in a matrixed, transnational organization.

- Curiosity and desire to discover new IT tools and service

- Language: Full professional fluency in both Spanish and English (written and spoken) is essential.

-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Recruitment Process
Interested candidates have to submit their resume in English.
You can always check the status of your application on the Workday website.
After your application through Workday, in the majority of cases, the stages will be:
- A Recruiter reviews your application.

- You will be contacted and/or interviewed by a Recruiter.

- An interview with the Hiring Manager will be scheduled.

- If needed, a last interview with the Hiring Team will be scheduled.

- The Hiring Team decides on the final candidate.

- Offer call with a Recruiter.

- A contract is signed.

- Operación de Red: Administrar plataformas LAN, WAN (SpiderWAN), conectividad a Internet y servicios de red (DNS, Active Directory).

- Soporte AV: Garantizar el funcionamiento de salas de videoconferencia y sistemas de cámaras para eventos y operaciones diarias.

postings.description:
Job Description:

Company Statement

Airbus Protect is a wholly owned subsidiary of Airbus Group. We are a risk management leader in safety, cybersecurity and sustainability.

We protect businesses and products from end-to-end, going beyond mere compliance to strengthen incident prevention and resilience at every level.

The Role
As a Cyber Security Consultant at Airbus Protect, you will act as a trusted advisor to our clients, delivering expert guidance across a diverse range of sectors. This is a multi-faceted role designed for someone who can help our customers navigate the increasingly complex threat and regulatory landscapes. You will be navigating both tactical and technical compliance challenges alongside high-level strategic risk management.

Due to the sensitive nature of the projects we deliver for our clients, it is an essential requirement that you currently hold, or meet the criteria to obtain, UK Government Security Clearance. This foundational requirement goes hand-in-hand with our need for a proven track record in cyber security consulting. We expect your practical experience navigating complex GRC challenges to be firmly underpinned by recognised industry certifications—such as CISSP, CISM, or ISO 27001—demonstrating your established capability to advise clients with authority and technical rigor.

Key Responsibilities may include:

Governance
- Strategic Consulting: Advise clients on sound security architecture principles, including Secure by Design, network segmentation, and zero-trust frameworks, ensuring technical solutions align with business priorities.
- Technical Advisory: Lead engagements on specialised areas providing both high-level strategy and technical oversight. Providing consultancy on complex technical topics such as IDAM, PAM, and DLP, translating these into clear, actionable business advice.
- Regulatory Guidance: Advise and assure compliance against current and emerging frameworks/standards and regulations such as ISO27001, ISA/IEC62443, NIST CSF, NIST 800-53, NCSC CAF, NIS2, the Cyber Resilience Act, the AI Act, EASA Part-IS.
- AI Integration: Leverage AI tools to optimise internal delivery while consulting customers on the secure adoption and governance of AI within their own environments and in regulatory compliance.
- Multi-Project Leadership: Efficiently manage and execute multiple client engagements simultaneously, prioritising deliverables, driving project timelines, and consistently delivering quality consulting outputs while maintaining strong customer relationships across various industry sectors.

Risk
- Risk Management: Produce high-quality risk assessments and assurance artefacts across the full system lifecycle, tailoring your approach to the client’s specific business context, including consideration of technical and human factors.
- Risk Mitigation & Guidance: Translate technical gaps and architectural risks into prioritised, actionable remediation plans, advising delivery teams and business stakeholders on achieving compliance and long-term cyber resilience.
- Gap assessment: Conduct comprehensive gap assessments against relevant cybersecurity standards, frameworks, and regulations (e.g., ISO27001, ISA/IEC62443, NIST CSF, NIST 800-53, NCSC CAF, NIS2, the Cyber Resilience Act, the AI Act, EASA Part-IS) to evaluate client security postures, identify control deficiencies, and deliver prioritised, actionable remediation roadmaps that guide clients toward full compliance readiness.

Compliance
- Cyber Resilience: Devise and test strategies that ensure clients can withstand and respond to cyber incidents.
- Secure Design & Baseline Assurance: Evaluate system architectures and technical configurations against established security baselines and Secure by Design principles. Identify design and configuration vulnerabilities early in the delivery lifecycle, providing actionable recommendations to guide customers toward secure, resilient, and compliant solutions.

Supporting New Business:
Beyond technical delivery, you will play a supporting role in the growth and market presence of Airbus Protect:
- Content Creation: Authoring technical blogs, white papers, and insights on emerging security trends to enhance our brand authority.
- Sales and Marketing Support: Support to Sales and Marketing colleagues with technical representation at customer and marketing events. Developing compelling case studies and service descriptions aligned with our services portfolio. Representing Airbus at webinars, industry panels, and conferences to showcase our expertise.
- Business Development: Active participation in the bid process and supporting ongoing customer relationship management to identify new opportunities.

The Individual
We are seeking a proactive self-starter capable of taking a forward-looking approach to understanding customer requirements by providing effective inputs that add tangible benefit to the customer’s business.
Essential Requirements:
- Experience: 5–10 years of experience in a cyber security consulting or technical leadership role
- Clearance: Must hold, or have the ability to obtain, UK Government Security Clearance.
- Qualifications: At least one of the following certifications (CISSP, CISM, CCSP, CISA, ISO 27001, GICSP, ISA62443) or equivalents.
- Frameworks and Standards: Demonstrable experience of regulatory compliance and Standards adherence.
- Mindset: A self-starter who stays ahead of the curve on threat intelligence and industry best practices.
- Communication: Exceptional presentation skills; able to communicate complex technical topics to non-technical stakeholders.
- Collaboration: Proven ability to work autonomously while contributing effectively to multiple virtual and transnational teams and customers across concurrent projects.
- AI Literacy: Demonstrable understanding of how to use AI tools for productivity and the principles of securing AI environments.
- Business Acumen: Demonstrable evidence of business support benefits undertaken and realised
- Mobility: Full UK Driving Licence.
- Locality: Whilst this is a Hybrid Role, you will be expected to be in our Bristol office for at least 2-3 days a week.

Remuneration & Benefits
- Competitive Salary
- Annual profit share scheme.
- Comprehensive company benefits and private healthcare options consistent with a market-leading transnational organisation.

postings.description:
Job Description:
Job Description

Group Manager: Identity & Access Management (IAM) DevSecOps Practice

Date: 11/05/2026 Location: Bengaluru, India

About Position:
Are you passionate about IT security, access governance, and its application across a global enterprise? Are you experienced in modern cloud-native security paradigms and convinced by the business added value of embedding automated Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) and DevSecOps practices across a complex product landscape?
Airbus is looking for a Group Manager IAM & DevSecOps Practice Lead to join the Bengaluru, India location.

Position Overview: Lead the global Identity and Access Management (IAM) engineering team within the Enterprise CyberSecurity & Infrastructure Department. Beyond direct operational delivery, this critical role serves as the global Practice Lead for all SREs and DevSecOps professionals across the entire IAM landscape. The scope encompasses securing and driving resilience across both commercial off-the-shelf (COTS) integrations and bespoke internally-built (Make) applications. Success requires exceptional disciplinary leadership, deep identity-centric security expertise, and the capability to foster a high-performance culture of automated, secure engineering.
The successful candidate will establish team goals by identifying, evaluating, and understanding the business strategy & technical trends. He/She will accomplish the team results/performance by communicating job expectations, planning, monitoring, coaching, and leading the team in the right direction.

Qualification & Experience
- Education: Master's or Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Cyber Security, Information Technology, or a relevant engineering discipline.

- Experience: 12+ years in Cyber Security, Identity Management, and IT Operations, including proven disciplinary leadership, team management, and global platform ownership.

- Domain Knowledge: Professional background in managing critical enterprise scale environments is required (Aerospace industry background is a plus). Highly specific expertise in Identity Governance, Enterprise Security Architectures, and global practice leadership is mandatory.

- Technical Stack & Domain Expertise: Architectural proficiency in modern identity and deployment ecosystems, specifically:
- IAM Core: Single Sign-On (SSO), Federation (SAML, OIDC, OAuth 2.0), Customer/Enterprise IAM (e.g., Okta, Ping Identity, Azure AD/Entra ID), Directory Services, and Privilege Access Management (PAM - e.g., CyberArk).

- IGA & Compliance: Identity Governance & Administration (IGA - e.g., SailPoint), lifecycle management, and automated access provisioning/de-provisioning.

- DevSecOps Automation: Continuous security integration (SAST/DAST, dependency scanning), Infrastructure as Code (IaC - Terraform, Ansible), Policy as Code (Open Policy Agent), and automated CI/CD security gating.

- SRE Frameworks: Continuous monitoring, observability (e.g., Dynatrace, Datadog, Prometheus), error budgets, automated incident remediation, and high-availability architecture for identity services.

- Product Landscapes: Managing and securing mixed portfolios spanning global COTS platforms (enterprise software deployments) and custom Make cloud-native applications.

- Preferred Certifications:
- Security & Identity Certifications: CISSP, CCSP, CISM, or advanced vendor-specific certifications (Okta Certified Professional, Microsoft Identity and Access Administrator).

- SRE & DevOps Certifications: Certified DevSecOps Professional, AWS/Azure DevOps Engineer Expert.

- Service & Project Management: ITIL v4, PMP, or SAFe Agilist.

- Methodologies: Advanced knowledge of Agile/SAFe frameworks, SRE principles (SLA/SLO/SLI management), DevSecOps maturity matrices, and Zero Trust security models.

- Travel: Willingness to travel to Europe for up to 1 month p.a., if needed on short notice.

- Language & Soft Skills: Business-fluent English and strong communication skills for continuous collaboration with European partners, product owners, and engineering leads globally. Proficiency in German is a plus.

Core Responsibilities
- Team Leadership & Practice Guild: Manage, coach, and develop the local IAM engineering team. Serve as the global Guild/Practice Lead for SRE and DevSecOps engineering across IAM PSL, driving capability models, standardization of blueprints, and talent upskilling across disparate product teams.

- Global IAM Operations: Ensure high-availability, low-latency identity service operations (strict SLA fulfillment) and secure access management across all global corporate touchpoints.

- COTS & Make Security Governance: Oversee the secure onboarding and structural lifecycle management of all COTS packages and custom Make applications spread across the global Airbus landscape, ensuring strict alignment with security baselines.

- Technical Steer: Enforce modern identity engineering and SRE standards, driving the absolute transition toward automated, shift-left DevSecOps principles and cloud-native cloud identity architectures.

- Intercultural Orchestration: Act as the strategic and operational bridge between the Bengaluru hub and global European partners, unifying engineering methodologies across global product boundaries.

- Empowerment & Culture: Empower team members by delegating authority and encouraging individual responsibility for system reliability and security goals. Cultivate a workplace environment that mirrors the organization's strategic digital objectives.

- Logistics & Governance: Administer operational logistics including global shift rotations, follow-the-sun operational structures, and leave management. Ensure clear, transparent, and effective communication across the team.

- Escalation & Incident Management: Actively resolve critical identity-related security escalations, lead post-mortem root-cause analysis (RCA) for operational outages, and protect corporate SLAs.

- Continuous Improvement: Apply enterprise-wide perspectives to identify and address emerging threat vectors and reliability challenges. Regularly integrate lessons learned to drive multi-axial continuous improvement. Collaborate with senior management and project boards to provide progress updates.

Success Metrics
Success will be measured in a variety of areas, including but not limited to:
- Successful deployment and adoption of standardized DevSecOps and SRE practices across all global Airbus application portfolios.

- Flawless SLA fulfillment, high availability, and near-zero downtime of core enterprise IAM platforms globally.

- Accelerated remediation times of security vulnerabilities within CI/CD pipelines across COTS integrations and Make products.

- Collaborative way of working, rapid reaction times in case of operational identity issues or security escalations.

- Bringing innovative, cost-effective, and robust automated identity solutions.

- Achieving high internal customer and developer community satisfaction.

postings.title: Head of Business Continuity Manager (m/w/d)
postings.description:
Job Description:
Job Description

As a Business Continuity Manager Germany, you will be a strategic leader responsible for establishing and driving our Business Continuity Management (BCM) program in one of our key markets. Reporting to senior leadership and working closely with our global colleagues and divisional stakeholders, you will ensure that our operations remain resilient and our risks are proactively managed. Your role will be critical in protecting our assets, reputation and overall business stability through effective planning, training and incident management.

Accountabilities

- The jobholder is fully accountable for the strategic design, greenfield establishment, and sustained excellence of the Business Continuity Management (BCM) programme across the ADS Division's designated countries (in the country assigned to this position), where no prior formal BCM system exists. This encompasses leadership over all key BCM processes, including rigorous Business Impact Analyses (BIAs), the development of comprehensive continuity plans, and serving as the designated National BCM Risk Owner with full delegated authority for integrating all threat and vulnerability assessments into the Enterprise Risk Management (ERM) framework. A critical part of this accountability is the successful achievement and ongoing maintenance of the ISO 22301 certification, ensuring full compliance with both internal and international BCM standards.
- Furthermore, the position is accountable for driving organisational BCM readiness by designing and executing comprehensive, scenario-based training and exercises for all staff levels. This includes the direct management and oversight of external teams/vendors critical to the BCM deployment and ongoing operations. The jobholder must leverage interdisciplinary expertise to deeply understand and integrate the specific needs of all major business functions, and must provide expert tactical support during real-world incidents, followed by thorough post-incident evaluations to ensure continuous program improvement.
- If the Business Continuity Manager fails to perform their duties effectively, or if the position remains vacant, the organisation risks being ill-prepared to respond to significant disruptions such as cyber incidents, natural disasters, or supply chain breakdowns. This could result in prolonged operational downtime, the loss of critical data, failure to meet contractual or regulatory obligations, and serious financial and reputational damage. Within a highly regulated and security-sensitive industry such as defence and space, such shortcomings could further undermine national security commitments, erode stakeholder confidence, and expose the organisation to legal or governmental sanctions.

Dimensions

- The jobholder is responsible for the strategic vendor selection, contract management, and oversight of BCM-related external sub-contracted services and vendors. The role has a P&L influence through direct management of the Operating Budget.

Main Activities

- The main activities center on defining and driving the multi-year BCM roadmap and leading the end-to-end transformation of BCM from a nascent state to a mature, certified program across multiple international sites. This is achieved by defining and implementing the overarching BCM strategy, developing the foundational policies and procedures, and ensuring their strict alignment with the global divisional framework.
- A key deliverable is the continuous elevation of the organisation's readiness level through the design and delivery of a mandatory training curriculum and the execution of high-fidelity, cross-functional simulation exercises. These activities drive value by systematically reducing business interruption risk and ensuring a swift, coordinated response to any crisis scenario.
- The jobholder's impact is also seen in the management of complex external vendor relationships and cross-functional teams to deploy digital BCM tools and ensure all Business Impact Analyses are rooted in a deep, interdisciplinary understanding of the entire ADS Division's operations. This value creation is essential for protecting the company's assets and reputation.

Outputs

- The primary output is a fully operational, ISO 22301-certified Business Continuity Management System in the designated country, transitioning from a greenfield status to a mature, auditable program compliant with all regulatory and corporate standards. This output includes a suite of validated BCM documentation.
- A critical output is the generation of a robust BCM Risk Profile for the country, derived from comprehensive threat and vulnerability assessments, which is formally integrated and reported as part of the Enterprise Risk Management (ERM) process.
- The role delivers a measurable increase in organisational resilience and preparedness, evidenced by post-exercise reports, lower recovery times, and a highly engaged staff culture achieved through a structured and successful annual BCM training and exercise program.

Key Requirements

Work Experience
- Depth of Experience: Minimum of 5-7 years' experience in Business Continuity Management, Risk Management, or a related field.
- Program Management: Proven track record of successfully implementing and managing comprehensive, country-level Business Continuity programs and plans.
- Implementation & Oversight: Direct experience in conducting Business Impact Analyses (BIAs) and developing localized BC plans for critical business units.
- Team & Project Leadership: Experience in leading or mentoring a small local team or managing cross-functional project teams within a single country or business unit.
- Language Skills (Mandatory): Fluent in both German and English (written and spoken) is required, as this role manages local regulatory/operational stakeholders in Germany while coordinating with global teams.

Core Competencies
- Analytical & Implementation Skills: Strong analytical skills with a practical understanding of business risk assessments and the execution of BCM policies.
- BCM Execution: Ability to successfully implement and monitor BC plans and governance structures at the country level.
- Project Management: Strong project management skills necessary to drive collaboration across local functions and departments.
- Communication: Strong communication skills, able to effectively liaise with local and regional management, technical teams, and relevant country-level stakeholders.
- Adaptability: Ability to manage complex projects and adapt quickly to evolving local risks and regulatory changes.

Educational Background & Certifications
- Education: Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Risk Management, or a related field is required.
- Certifications (Preferred): Relevant certifications such as ISO 22301 Lead Implementer, ISO 27001, or equivalent.

Additional Attributes
- A proactive mindset with a focus on continuous improvement in local operational resilience.
- Strong organizational skills and the ability to manage resource allocation effectively.

postings.description:
Job Description:
Intitulé du poste : Ingénieur Validation Système Cybersécurité (F/H)

Qui sommes-nous ?
Au sein du Airbus Helicopters Drone Center, né de la fusion entre Survey Copter et Airbus Helicopters, nous concevons, fabriquons et assurons le maintien en conditions opérationnelles de systèmes de drones tactiques légers, destinés à des missions militaires et civiles. Nous couvrons l’ensemble du cycle de vie de ses systèmes, offrant à chacun la possibilité de contribuer pleinement à des projets technologiques et concrets.
Filiale à 100% du groupe Airbus depuis 2011, elle est le centre d’expertise drones d’Airbus Helicopters, implantée à Pierrelatte (sa maison mère) et à Aix les Milles.
Nous rejoindre, c’est intégrer des sites à taille humaine et des équipes passionnées, tout en profitant d’un cadre de vie privilégié dans la Drome ou les Bouches du Rhône, territoires dynamiques et ensoleillés.
Pour en savoir plus sur nos produits UAS (Uncrewed Aerial Systems):
https://www.airbus.com/en/products-services/defence/uas

Ce que nous pouvons accomplir ensemble :
Au sein du Bureau d'Études de Pierrelatte, vous jouerez un rôle clé dans la fiabilisation et la sécurité de nos systèmes de drones. Vous aurez pour mission de :
- Valider la performance système : Piloter les campagnes de tests (End-to-End) pour garantir le bon comportement du système et assurer la non-régression.

- Sécuriser nos architectures (SSI) : Assurer le durcissement des OS et des GPO, créer des ISOs sécurisés et gérer le cycle de vie des vulnérabilités (CVE/correctifs).

- Optimiser l'expérience utilisateur et l'intégration : Participer à l'ergonomie des stations sol et accompagner l'intégration de nouveaux périphériques matériels/logiciels.

- Garantir la conformité : Rédiger la documentation technique et constituer les preuves de conformité pour les autorités.

Au quotidien, vous apporterez également votre expertise pour résoudre les faits techniques SSI, accompagner le service production dans la reproduction des configurations et supporter l'intégration Security by Design au sein du Bureau d'Études.
Ce poste nécessite une habilitation de sécurité ou nécessite d’être éligible à une habilitation par les autorités reconnues.

Qui êtes-vous ?
De formation Bac +5 avec une spécialité en Cybersécurité, Ingénierie Système ou Logiciel, vous avez au moins 3 ans d'expérience dans l'industrie.
Ce que l’on reconnait chez vous :

postings.description:
Job Description:
Take off with Airbus Helicopters!

Airbus Helicopters is looking for an Insurance Risk Manager (m/f) to join the Finance Department based in Marignane, France.

Join us to shape the future of aeronautics and help protect lives during missions accomplished thanks to our helicopters. The Marignane site, the 3rd largest industrial site in France, near Marseille and Aix-en-Provence, is undergoing a deep transformation to offer a high-tech, inclusive, and environmentally friendly working environment. You will have a unique professional experience, at the heart of the manufacturing of our helicopters. To learn more about our site and our activities: Airbus Helicopters - Marignane

Your future missions:
Part of an international team covering all insurance activities across the entire Airbus Group, you will manage all insurance activities related to entities located in France as well as in other European and non-European countries. The role has a transversal function for all core insurance lines (aviation, property liability, cyber, transport, employee benefit, construction) with the purpose of proactively managing insurable risks, protecting Airbus people, assets and liabilities against financial consequences, considering the specific needs of the business.
Your main missions will be:
- Ensure continuous and consistent identification, evaluation, and assessment of insurable risks across Airbus Helicopters.
- Initiate and monitor appropriate mitigation and risk avoidance measures for identified and evaluated insurable risks.
- Lead the management of claims until full payment in coordination with the business and relevant stakeholders (experts, brokers, lawyers).
- Support the Head of Insurances with the handling of product liability claims managed by Legal and follow up on the financial impact.
- Assure an excellent level of insurance expertise to provide advice and support to all business partners dealing with insurance matters.
- Ensure cross-functional coordination of tasks with other departments (Legal, Programs, Procurement, Sales, HR, site, etc.), subsidiaries, and external stakeholders (brokers and insurers).
- Provide contractual support on insurance conditions to secure the best interests of the business during Mergers & Acquisitions and bid/tender processes in coordination with Legal, ensuring that contractual insurance requirements are consistent with the group's insurance coverage.
- Perform insurance awareness sessions and workshops for different areas of the company, acting as a key point of contact for operational insurance and risk matters.

Your profile:
- Master's degree in Insurance, Business, Law, Finance, or a related field. This is a highly visible expert function requiring solid foundational knowledge in these areas.
- Minimum 5 years of relevant experience in operational risk and the insurance field.
- Prior experience in an international environment will be highly appreciated.
- English: Mandatory (fluent/negotiation level).
- French: Prerequisite.
- Soft skills: Reliability, ability to work autonomously and manage multiple topics simultaneously. Pragmatic and proactive approach with strong organizational and communication skills. Capacity to interact effectively with stakeholders from different functions, and the ability to thrive in a small collaborative team environment.
This position requires a security clearance or will require being eligible for clearance by the recognized authorities.

3 Reasons to join us:
Our Values: Six essential values form the core of our company. Defined for employees by employees, our Airbus values shape the DNA of our business, reflecting the unique mix of qualities found in each member of our global family. Inclusion and diversity: We foster an inclusive and rewarding work environment, where everyone's diversity is valued and respected. An inclusive and diverse workforce is the engine of innovation at Airbus. It makes us unique and contributes to better problem-solving. Compensation and benefits: At Airbus, we build the future together and your success is our priority. Expect a global, competitive, and transparent compensation package (including salaries, bonuses, profit-sharing, participation, and preferred share ownership plan), designed to reward the impact and performance you bring, both individually and collectively. We invest in your complete well-being: professional development (training, mentoring, international mobility), health coverage, retirement, and a commitment to a supported work-life balance (parental support, flexibility). And for your daily life, benefits that make a difference:
- A dynamic CSE (Social and Economic Committee) offering many advantages (company restaurant, children's leisure center, associations and sports complex, travel allowances, etc.).
- Transport facilities: Take advantage of our company shuttles or the reimbursement of your annual transport pass.

postings.description:
Job Description:
Job Description
Role: IT / Application Architect – OpenShift Platform
Number of Positions: 1
Location: Bangalore, India
Description
Airbus Commercial Aircraft is looking for an IT Architect to join our Aircraft Test and Delivery department based in Bangalore, India.
You will be part of a team developing applications in the scope of an initiative for a collaborative platform supporting “Customer Line” operations and Customer relationships all along the aircraft Acceptance & Delivery process.

This PSL embedding the products used for :
● The activities related to the technical progress of the Production Aircrafts for the activities managed in the delivery center, in the flight line for ALL programs and for ALL Sites:Toulouse / Tianjin / Mobile / Hamburg / Mirabel
● The products and means used to communicate with the customer during the delivery of the aircraft that he is purchasing: Invitations, Orientation during visits in Plant/FAL,Technical Status, Request of Rework, planning dates, ...relying on the data which are managed within other Business Products
● The product & tools used to measure & drumbeat the progress of the Aircraft from end of manufacturing to delivery of the Aircraft: prioritization of Aircraft, Live technical status, escalation of critical Items, allocation/management of teams, efficiency of Actors
● The preparation & execution of the tests of the aircrafts on production Aircrafts: Noise detection, scheduling of flights, preparation of flights
Within the Digital & IM organization, we are seeking a highly experienced and passionate IT / Application Architect specializing in RedHat OpenShift (OCP 4) to join our team in Bangalore, India. You will play a pivotal role in designing, architecting, and modernizing cloud-native microservices, hybrid container platforms, and edge/PWA application topologies.
In this role, you will collaborate with cross-functional Agile teams, enterprise architects, and engineering leads to deliver secure, resilient, and high-performing enterprise application solutions.

Qualifications & Experience
● Education: Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related discipline.
● Experience: 10 - 14+ years of total IT experience with at least 5–8 years of experience designing, architecting, and operating complex enterprise applications and containerized platform topologies.
● Agile Expertise: Minimum 2-3 years working in cross-functional Agile/SAFe or Scrum teams from inception through release.
● Language: Advanced proficiency in English (verbal and written).

Technical Skills & Requirements
1. Platform & Runtime Architecture
● RedHat OpenShift (OCP 4): Extensive hands-on design and architecture experience scaling cluster states across OCP namespaces, optimizing Horizontal Pod Autoscalers (HPA), and configuring Pod Disruption Budgets (PDB).
● RedHat Source-to-Image (S2I): Proven ability to manage production artifact builds leveraging RedHat Universal Base Images (UBI9).
● Runtimes & Servers: Deep architectural knowledge of Java (OpenJDK 17, Spring, Quarkus) for microservices and batch systems, NodeJS 24 / ReactJS / Redux for front-end platforms, as well as Apache HTTPd 2.4 & Tomcat 10 for reverse proxying, valve logging, and runtime baselines.

2. System Design & Edge / PWA Topology
● Local-First Storage Patterns: Capability to architect high-availability offline-capable web apps using browser-based storage patterns (IndexedDB).
● Offline Data Synchronization: Design offline action capture to perform synchronization through replay-mode, validating operations using cryptographic signatures
● Layered Gateway Topologies & APIs: Building decoupled API fabrics and API Gateways to govern curated internal datasets safely out to consumer boundaries.

3. DevSecOps, Identity & Compliance
● Federated Identity & SSO: Expertise in managing enterprise Single Sign-On (SSO) bridges, OAuth 2.0 / OpenID Connect (OIDC) over MobileSSO for both user (U2M) and machine (M2M) authentication.
● Peer-to-Peer Cryptography: Implementing cross-component token isolation utilizing signed and encrypted JSON Web Encryption (JWE) tokens via custom key configurations.
● Logical Export Controls: Implementing logical workspace borders separating restricted datasets (e.g., military ITAR data) based on contextual program variables.
● Segregated Audit Logging: Design dedicated log routing and indexing to maintain secure audit trails separate from standard application operational logs.

4. CI/CD & Automation
● Ansible Automation Platform: Writing infrastructure-as-code playbooks and managing cluster credentials securely via Ansible Vault.
● Pipeline Engineering: Constructing automated multi-stage compilation workflows using Jenkins pipelines integrated with enterprise GitHub repositories.
● DevSecOps Integration: Injecting static security inspection tools (SonarQube, CheckmarxOne, DefectDojo) into routine CI/CD pipelines.

5. Data & Core Infrastructure
● Oracle DB Topology: Configuring high-availability SQL*Net database connections targeting remote Oracle virtual instances bound to active Data Guard pools.
● Multi-Protocol Volumes: Mounting cluster-external network file spaces utilizing SFTP, NFS v4, or SMB/CIFS combined with active Kerberos validation.
● Perimeter Firewalls & Proxies: Designing and monitoring data pipelines traversing Data Center Filtering (DCF) firewalls and AxessGate proxy publication pathways.

Nice-to-Have Requirements
● Network Segregation: Experience restructuring container topologies to partition high-volume automated Machine-to-Machine (M2M) traffic separate from User-to-Machine (U2M) endpoints.
● NoSQL & Caching: Experience supporting persistence over MongoDB clusters and memory-based engine Redis.
● Relational Databases: Broad experience connecting microservices directly via SQL*Net to highly available PostgreSQL and Oracle instances.

Responsibilities & Tasks
● Solution Architecture & Design: Define and validate solution and application architectures for new and existing IT products using RedHat OpenShift (OCP 4) and cloud infrastructure.
● Dossier & Blueprint Authoring: Produce Architectural Requirement Dossiers (ARD) detailing logical, physical, network, and security layers using Archimate or standard UML modeling.
● Security & Compliance: Ensure full adherence to cyber security standards, zero-trust concepts, export control regulations (EC, Dual-Use, ITAR), and audit logging requirements.
● Stakeholder & Community Alignment: Collaborate with Enterprise Architects, Product Owners, and DevOps teams to align technical choices with business strategies.
● Mentoring & Leadership: Guide development and operations teams on cloud-native best practices, design patterns, and clean code principles.
● Innovation & Lifecycle Management: Evaluate new technologies and tools to continually optimize cost, performance, scalability, and maintainability.

Success Metrics
● Quality & On-Time Delivery: Consistently deliver high-quality ("first-time-right") architectural solutions on schedule.
● Innovation & Cost Optimization: Propose cost-effective, innovative application and infrastructure solutions.
● Customer & Stakeholder Satisfaction: Achieve high satisfaction levels from business domains and global enterprise IT partners.
● Team Synergy: Foster strong collaboration across local and international cross-functional teams.

We love your interest in joining Airbus! There is no limit on the number of positions you can apply for, however, please be aware that you can only progress in the selection process for one position at a time. We recommend reviewing all available opportunities and applying to those that best match your experience and aspirations.

Salary: £24,246

35 hours per week // Flexible working hours // Hybrid working options available depending on the role // Half day Fridays! // 25 days holiday plus bank holidays

About us:

Would you like to understand how Airbus’ External Partners work effectively & connect with Airbus IT systems?

The Digital Extended Enterprise (EE) Team enables efficient and secure IT connectivity and collaboration between any Airbus department and Airbus Third-Parties (Suppliers, Customers, Affiliates, authorities…).

The team defines and industrialises the standard IT solutions & processes that should be used by the external partners of Airbus for their connectivity to Airbus’ Information Systems and Information Technology (IS/IT) systems.

We collaborate with external partners and the other Airbus teams to prepare the strategy for the future, while ensuring compliance with Cyber security, data compliance, and ensuring business continuity.

Our team leads various projects to :
- Standardise the solutions;
- Simplify the way our external partners are connecting to our Airbus IT systems;
- Ensure and recover compliance to our Airbus EE standards;
- Optimise our EE processes and share/publish/educate about these standard processes.

What you will be doing:

As a member of the Digital Extended Enterprise Solutions team, you will be part of a truly dynamic international team with personnel based in core Airbus countries across Europe, as well as in Portugal, India, and Canada.

Your role will be varied, and your activities will be connected with one of our improvement, industrialisation or compliance recovery projects.
This may include:

- Helping to develop new connection solutions and new EE standards;
- Investigating major incidents that occur in service;
- Liaising with external partners on technical issues;
- New solution roll-out and migration of external partners’ end-users;
- Creating documentation and video materials to train users and administrators;
- Presenting and promoting Extended Enterprise solutions and services within Airbus;
- Contributing to or potentially leading Extended Enterprise compliance recovery campaigns.

During this internship you will have the opportunity to develop your project management, service management and communication skills, operating in a fully international context.

- Customer-oriented mindset;

- Reliability and creativity;
- Ability to work as a team as well as independently;
- Global understanding/appreciation of Enterprise IT systems/infrastructure;
- Ability to develop relationships and communicate effectively with different levels of stakeholders.

postings.description:
Job Description:
Airbus Helicopters is looking for an IT Product Manager – Quality Applications & Portfolio (f/m) to join our team based in Marignane, France.

We are seeking a senior IT Product Manager who executes at cross-functional communication and technical orchestration.

In this role, you will lead our core Non-Conformity Management (NCM) application—a backbone for the company—while overseeing monthly governance across a portfolio of ~10 applications in the Quality & Flight Safety perimeter.

The ideal candidate is an adaptable communicator who can engage directly with shop-floor end users, align product roadmaps with the Business and Management, and hold discussions with dedicated technical specialists (Integration, Identity/IAM, Security, Infrastructure) without needing to perform the engineering work directly.

Your working environment:

Major economic hub with Marseille-Provence Airport, Marignane is a dynamic city in the southeast of France. It is located near the cities of Aix-en-Provence and Marseille, which host a rich cultural and tourist offer. Close to the beaches of the Côte Bleue, it offers many options for water sports activities.

How we care for you:

- Financial rewards: Attractive salary, agreements on success and profit sharing schemes, employee savings plan abounded by Airbus and employee stock purchase plan on a voluntary basis.
- Work / Life Balance: Extra days-off for special occasions, holiday transfer option, a Staff council offering many social, cultural and sport activities and other services.
- Wellbeing / Health: Complementary health insurance coverage (disability, invalidity, death). Depending on the site: health services center, concierge services, gym, carpooling application.
- Individual development: Great upskilling opportunities and development prospects with unlimited access to +10.000 e-learning courses to develop your employability, certifications, expert career path, accelerated development programmes, national and international mobility.

At Airbus, we support you to work, connect and collaborate more easily and flexibly. Wherever possible, we foster flexible working arrangements to stimulate innovative thinking.

Your challenges:

1. Product Leadership – Non-Conformity Management (NCM)
- E2E Lifecycle Ownership: Accountable for the entire lifecycle of the NCM product—including discovery, strategic roadmap, backlog prioritization, feature delivery, operational maintenance, user adoption, and continuous improvement/decommissioning.

postings.title: Junior Entwicklungsingenieur (d/m/w) Digitale High-Speed Elektronik für Raumfahrtanwendungen
postings.description:
Job Description:
Zur Unterstützung für das Team von Microwave Subsystems Engineering sucht sucht Airbus Defence and Space einen Entwicklungsingenieur (d/m/w) im Bereich Digitale High Speed Elektronik für Raumfahrtanwendungen.

Unser Team entwickelt hochmoderne Elektroniken zur Steuerung von Radar Nutzlasten und der Signal-Erzeugung und -Verarbeitung der Radarsignale. Diese FPGA basierten Elektroniken sind neben den harten Anforderungen durch die Raumfahrt Umgebung vor allem herausfordernd, da sehr schnelle digitale Signale digital/analog gewandelt, verarbeitet und übertragen werden müssen . Die Elektroniken dienen weiterhin der präzisen Echtzeitsteuerung aller funktionalen Abläufe in der Nutzlast. Wir suchen Unterstützung für unser Team, um diese Herausforderungen auch in der Zukunft zu meistern.

Standort
Am Airbus-Standort in Immenstaad am Bodensee arbeitest du dort, wo die Zukunft von Connected Intelligence, Space und Air Power entsteht. In einer Umgebung, die Weitblick bietet, gestaltest du technologische Innovationen über Domänen hinweg.
Unser Standort lebt vom Dialog: Auf dem Campus triffst du auf ein einzigartiges Netzwerk aus Experten für Satellitentechnik, militärische Luftfahrt, Cyber-Security, Künstliche Intelligenz sowie Combat Cloud und Ground Support von morgen. Auch unsere Zusammenarbeit ist geprägt von Dynamik – in agilen Teams widmen wir uns den komplexesten Fragestellungen, von KI-gestützter Erdbeobachtung bis zur sicheren Cloud-Architektur. Wer technologische Exzellenz und interdisziplinäre Zusammenarbeit sucht, findet hier das ideale Umfeld.

Unsere Benefits
- Faire Vergütung & Extras: Attraktive Vergütung und individuelle Zusatzleistungen, z. B. betriebliche Vorsorgemodelle, Mobilitätsangebote (bspw. Fahrradleasing) oder Mitarbeitervorteile bei kooperierenden Unternehmen gemäß unseren jeweils gültigen Richtlinien.
- Zeit für dich (und deine Angehörigen): 30 Tage Jahresurlaub gem. Tarifvertrag (35h/Woche); Vereinbarkeit von Familie & Beruf (Gleitzeit, mobiles Arbeiten, Teilzeit, Jobsharing, Sabbatical)
- Weiterkommen leicht gemacht: Ausgezeichnete Weiterbildungsmöglichkeiten und internationale, konzernweite Entwicklungsperspektiven
- Wohlfühlen am Arbeitsplatz: Betriebsarzt; umfassendes Gesundheitsangebot (Sportkurse, Präventionsangebote, uvm.), Kantine und Cafeteria, Kindertagesstätte am Standort
- Vielfalt verbindet: Arbeiten in einem diversen Umfeld, mit mehr als 140 Nationalitäten, in dem Austausch, Unterstützung und Vielfalt gelebt wird

Aufgaben und Verantwortlichkeiten

- Detailed Design von high-speed, mixed-signal Elektronik, nach Hochzuverlässigkeitsrichtlinien wie z.B. ECSS.
- Schaltungsentwurf in Mentor Xpedition sowie Layoutbetreuung intern und extern
- Signalintegritätsimulationen in Mentor Hyperlynx
- Erstellung der zugehörigen ECSS konformen Dokumentation wie z.B. Part Stress Analyse, Worst Case Analyse oder Design Reports.
- Inbetriebnahme und elektrische Vermessung von Prototypen sowie Flughardware
- Enge Zusammenarbeit mit anderen Disziplinen im Projektteam wie z.B. System Engineering, Verification Engineering und Firmware Design

Erforderliche Kenntnisse und Qualifikationen

- Abschluss in Nachrichtentechnik, Elektrotechnik oder vergleichbar
- Erste Erfahrungen im Schaltungsentwurf für Hochgeschwindigkeitsanwendungen
- Erfahrung mit professionellen Elektronik Entwicklungsanwendungen, idealerweise Mentor Xpedition
- Erfahrung im Entwurf von “Software Defined Radio Elektroniken" (RF/digital) sind von Vorteil
- Sehr gute Englischkenntnisse, Deutschkenntnisse sind von Vorteil

postings.title: Mission Systems Engineer
postings.description:
Job Description:
We are seeking a highly skilled, motivated, and proactive Computer Engineer to join our high-performing team. The ideal candidate will have a strong background in computer engineering, specifically within the aerospace sector. This is a challenging and rewarding opportunity to contribute to a cutting-edge project that demands precision, innovation, and an unwavering commitment to excellence.

RESPONSIBILITIES

As an integral part of our team, your primary responsibilities will include:
- Aerospace Computer Systems Engineering: System specification, technical guidance and oversight of suppliers, and final integration into the aircraft of computer systems and networks tailored for aerospace applications.

- Network Management: Design, configuration, optimization, and security management of network infrastructures to ensure high availability and performance.

- System Integration: Seamless integration of computer systems and networks within aerospace platforms, ensuring compatibility and efficiency.

- Technical Oversight: Supervision of technical aspects of projects, ensuring adherence to aerospace industry standards and project milestones.

- Cross-functional Collaboration: Working closely with multidisciplinary teams, including avionics, software, and systems engineering, to ensure effective communication and proactive problem-solving.

- ISR Mission & Avionics: Apply expertise in Intelligence, Surveillance, and Reconnaissance (ISR) Mission and Avionics disciplines to enhance system capabilities and performance.

- Development & Integration Activities: Lead and manage development and integration activities from requirements capture to verification and validation to achieve a qualified and certified system.

SKILLS

The ideal candidate will possess a strong technical profile with the following qualifications:
- Educational Background: Degree in Computer Engineering or related field, with a preference for a Master's degree in Computer Engineering.

- Aerospace Experience: Proven experience in computer engineering within the aerospace sector, with a deep understanding of aerospace systems and networks.

- Network Management: Extensive experience in managing and optimizing network infrastructures, including configuration, security, and performance tuning of protocols such as TCP/IP, UDP, and ARINC 664.

- Cybersecurity Knowledge: Knowledge of cybersecurity principles and network security practices is highly desirable.

- Technical Expertise: Proficiency in computer systems architecture, network protocols, and aerospace-specific technologies.

- Problem-Solving Skills: Exceptional ability to troubleshoot and resolve complex technical issues in a timely manner.

- Soft Skills: Proactiveness, excellent communication skills, assertiveness, adaptability, and the ability to work effectively under pressure. Willingness to travel as needed to support project requirements.

- Language Proficiency: Strong verbal and written skills in both Spanish and English.

WHICH BENEFITS WILL YOU HAVE AS AIRBUS EMPLOYEE?

At Airbus we are focused on our employees and their welfare. Take a look at some of our social benefits:
- Vacation days plus additional days-off along the year.

- Attractive salary.

- Hybrid model of working when possible, promoting the work-life balance.

- Collective transport service subject to working calendar/home location.

- Benefits such as life insurance, health insurance, employee stock options, retirement plan, or study grants.

- On-site facilities (among others): free canteen, kindergarten, medical office.

postings.description:
Airbus is committed to providing reasonable accommodations as an Equal Opportunity Employer to applicants with disabilities. If you require assistance or an accommodation to complete your application, please contact us at USCareers@airbus.com

- Notice: Know Your Rights: Workplace Discrimination is Illegal
- Notice: Pay Transparency Nondiscrimination (English)
- Aviso: Transparencia en el Pago No Discriminación (Spanish)

Job Description:
Are you a Network Engineer who thrives when the "data center" is a tactical field rig, a Starlink dish, and a multi-hop RF relay?
Airbus is looking for a hands-on Network Engineer to own the stability, security, and real-time diagnostics of the communications linking our Unmanned Aircraft Systems (UAS) to ground control stations. In this high-impact role, you won't just be managing routine server racks—you’ll be engineering resilient VPN, firewall, and wireless architectures across Linux and Windows devices operating in unpredictable field environments.
If you bring a background in tactical/expeditionary communications, WISP field networking, or remote SCADA environments—and enjoy designing systems that don't break far from a help desk—we want to hear from you. Help us shape the future of autonomous flight connectivity!

Meet the Team:
The Airbus Helicopters Flexrotor Program offers one of the most sophisticated small tactical unmanned aerial systems (STUAS) with vertical take-off and landing (VTOL). It can be used day or night by US and allied forces for a diverse range of intelligence, surveillance, target acquisition and reconnaissance (ISTAR) on land and at sea.

Your Working Environment:
Nestled in the heart of the spectacular Columbia River Gorge in Bingen, WA, our workplace offers innovation and the ability to contribute to game-changing solutions while enjoying the flexibility to spread your wings. Whether it's solving complex challenges, or celebrating victories, you’ll be part of a cohesive crew that thrives on innovation and the beauty that the Northwest has to offer!

How We Care for You:
- Financial Rewards: Competitive base salary, incentive compensation which may include profit sharing schemes, retirement savings plan and the ability to participate in an Employee Stock Ownership Plan (“ESOP”)

- Work/Life Balance: Paid time off including personal time, holidays and a generous paid parental leave program.

- Health & Welfare: Comprehensive insurance coverage including medical (traditional and high-deductible health plans), prescription, dental, vision, life, disability, Employee Assistance Plan (“EAP”) and other supplemental benefit coverages.

Your Challenges:
Network Architecture & Infrastructure Engineering: 35%
- Lead the design and evolution of network architecture across VPNs, firewalls, RF relays, Starlink links, and Ground Control Station (GCS) connectivity as deployments scale to a larger fleet.

- Configure and maintain VPN servers and clients, firewalls, routing, and related network services across mixed Windows and Linux environments.

- Design network architecture for scalability, ensuring configurations, infrastructure, and deployment approaches remain repeatable and maintainable as the fleet grows.

- Collect, manage, and route data flows between field-deployed UAS/GCS systems and home-base or office infrastructure.

- Maintain network topology documentation, interface definitions, and configuration standards across GCS variants and deployment sites.

Network Operations, Monitoring & Field Support: 35%
- Diagnose and resolve network issues including degraded or intermittent RF and satellite links, interference, obstruction, latency, packet loss, routing, and connectivity problems, primarily through remote troubleshooting.

- Establish network monitoring, logging, alerting, and health-check capabilities to identify and surface network issues proactively.

- Build, or partner with Software Engineering to develop, diagnostic tools and dashboards that provide operators with clear and actionable visibility into network health.

- Serve as the technical escalation point for network issues beyond operator or first-line troubleshooting capability.

- Provide occasional in-field support for complex network or communications issues that cannot be resolved remotely.

- Identify recurring network failure modes, perform root-cause analysis, and implement corrective actions that improve system reliability and reduce operator IT support burden.

Cybersecurity, Standardization & Operational Resilience: 30%
- Apply secure network design practices including network segmentation, secure remote access, VPN/encryption, firewall configuration, authentication, and access control across UAS and ground network infrastructure.

- Configure and harden Windows, Linux, VPN, firewall, and other network devices using established security baselines and configuration-control practices.

- Support vulnerability identification and remediation, security logging and monitoring, patching, and network security improvements across deployed systems.

- Develop and maintain standard operating procedures, secure configuration standards, troubleshooting guides, and operator documentation that enable field personnel to resolve common issues without requiring deep networking expertise.

- Ensure cybersecurity, network configurations, monitoring capabilities, and documentation remain standardized and maintainable across GCS variants and deployment locations.

Your Boarding Pass: (Required for consideration)
- Must possess a Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Systems Engineering, Information Technology, or a related field.

- Have a minimum of five (5) years of experience in network engineering, systems administration, or field communications, with direct, hands-on responsibility for network stability and troubleshooting (not primarily help-desk/tier-1 support).

- Demonstrated experience configuring and troubleshooting VPNs, firewalls, and routing across both Windows and Linux environments.

- Experience with wireless/RF networking and satellite communications (e.g., Starlink, VSAT, or similar), including working with degraded, intermittent, or high-latency links.

- Experience designing or scaling network architectures, not solely maintaining existing ones — you'll be shaping how our networks evolve as we grow.

- Scripting or automation experience (PowerShell and/or Python) sufficient to build basic diagnostic tools and health checks, or to partner effectively with a software engineering team on more complex tooling.

- Demonstrated ability to stabilize and improve an existing, imperfect network environment rather than only building greenfield systems.

- Strong working knowledge of TCP/IP networking fundamentals: routing, subnetting, NAT, DNS, DHCP.

- Proficiency configuring and troubleshooting VPNs (e.g., n2n or similar peer-to-peer/supernode-based VPN architectures), firewalls, and network security policies.

- VPN technology: n2n (or similar peer-to-peer/supernode VPN).

- Firewall platforms: pfSense, iptables/nftables, Windows Defender Firewall/advanced security (or equivalents).

Preferred Skills:
- Experience operating in field, remote, or expeditionary environments — tactical communications, WISP field networking, industrial/SCADA remote-site networking, or similar.

- Experience supporting non-technical end users (operators) in troubleshooting network issues, with an eye toward simplifying and self-service enablement.

- Experience securing field-deployed, tactical, aerospace, or defense networks, including VPNs, firewalls, encrypted communications, network segmentation, and secure remote access.

- Familiarity with DoD cybersecurity practices such as RMF, NIST SP 800-53, and DISA STIGs as they relate to network infrastructure and system hardening.

- Experience supporting vulnerability assessments, security configuration reviews, patching, or remediation of network and operating-system security findings.

- Cisco CCNA or CCNP (or equivalent vendor certification).

- Relevant military communications/signal corps training or certification.

- Relevant network or cybersecurity certification such as Security+, CCNP Security, CISSP, or equivalent practical experience.

Travel Required:
- Minimal- 5% Domestic and International

Citizenship:
- Must be a US Person under ITAR definition (U.S. Citizen, green card holder or person covered under our existing ITAR license)

Physical Requirements:
- Onsite or remote: 50% onsite in Bingen, WA

- Vision: able to see and read computer screens and other electronic equipment with screens, able to read documents, reports and engineering drawings. Daily

- Hearing: able to participate in conversations in person and via teleconference or phone and to hear sounds on the production floor including safety warnings or alarms. Daily.

- Administrative position only PPE required: Steel-toed shoes are required for all shop floor visits, appropriate hearing/eye protection may also be required when visiting the shop floor.

Salary range based on the required profile: $97k to $155k /year. Actual minimum and maximum may vary based on geographic differential. Individual pay is based on skills, experience, and other relevant factors. This position offers the following benefits: Medical insurance, Dental insurance, Vision insurance, Prescription insurance, Employee Assistance Program, Flexible Spending Accounts, Health Savings Accounts, Basic & Voluntary Life and Accidental Death & Dismemberment insurance, Short and Long-term Disability insurance, 401(k), Paid time off including paid holidays, Tuition Assistance, Bonus(es) subject to performance criteria. These are our current benefit offerings for the current plan year and are subject to change without notice.

Hardening of network equipment, traffic monitoring, firewall management, and threat detection.

Advanced technical support and collaboration with cybersecurity teams.
You will also contribute to the maintenance of the Test Support System, “MaTE” installed in the laboratories/Rigs.

University Degree level in Computer Engineering, Telecommunication, Aeronautical or Cybersecurity.
Minimum 3 years of experience in administration and security of local and private network.
Solid knowledge and practical application of CCN-STIC guidelines and courses.
Demonstrable experience in environments regulated by the National Security Framework (ENS).
Valued certifications: CCN-CERT STIC courses, CCNA, CCNP Security, or other network and security certifications.

Experience in public administration or entities handling sensitive information.
Proficiency in Cisco, Fortinet, Palo Alto Networks, and enterprise VPN tools.

Experience in Test Support Systems, especially MaTE environment for EF-2000 platform, will be valued.

SUMMARY OF POSITION　ポジションの内容

Communications Product Service Lines (PSL) to represent Infra and Digital Workplace Domain in front of other Airbus Functions.
The objective is to support the successful implementation and ongoing enhancement of our organization's network and communication solutions.
