postings.title: Study Engineer / Data Scientist (d/f/m) – AI & Operations Research
postings.description:
Job Description:
Zur Verstärkung der Abteilung "Operationelle Analyse und Studien" suchen wir bei Airbus Defence and Space in Friedrichshafen in den nächsten Monaten für zukünftige Projekte eine/n
Study Engineer / Data Scientist (d/f/m) – AI & Operations Research

Wir untersuchen innovative zukünftige Technologien (darunter auch eigene aus dem Hause Airbus) und deren Einsatz im operationellen Umfeld mit Hilfe unseres hauseigenen Simulationsframeworks.

Unsere Hauptaufgabe ist dabei die Konzeption und Durchführung theorie- und datengetriebener Studien. Wir bilden komplexe Systemarchitekturen („Systems of Systems“) mathematisch und algorithmisch ab, optimieren und evaluieren diese. Damit beeinflussen wir frühzeitige Entwurfsentscheidungen und geben richtungsweisende Empfehlungen im Bereich zukünftiger Entwicklungen und Einsätze ab.

Wir suchen einen Study Engineer / Data Scientist (d/f/m), der uns bei der Erforschung und Anwendung von Methoden der Künstlichen Intelligenz, komplexer Modellbildung bis hin zur tiefgehenden Datenauswertung unterstützt. Du arbeitest in unserer agilen Studienabteilung an interessanten Studien- und Forschungsprojekten der Bundeswehr, NATO sowie Europäischen Union im Bereich Sicherheit und Verteidigung.

Respekt, Teamwork und Kreativität sind die Schlüsselwerte unserer Abteilung. Als Studienabteilung sind wir aktiv in Innovationsaktivitäten im Bereich Künstliche Intelligenz, Machine Learning, Block Chain oder Quantencomputing involviert. Zusammen mit der Airbus Innovation Factory in Friedrichshafen findest du bei uns das richtige Umfeld, um deine innovativen, theoretischen und algorithmischen Ideen voranzutreiben und in die Realität umzusetzen.
Dein Standort
Am Airbus-Standort in Immenstaad am Bodensee arbeitest du dort, wo die Zukunft von Connected Intelligence, Space und Air Power entsteht. In einer Umgebung, die Weitblick bietet, gestaltest du technologische Innovationen über Domänen hinweg.

Unser Standort lebt vom Dialog: Auf dem Campus triffst du auf ein einzigartiges Netzwerk aus Experten für Satellitentechnik, militärische Luftfahrt, Cyber-Security, Künstliche Intelligenz sowie Combat Cloud und Ground Support von morgen. Auch unsere Zusammenarbeit ist geprägt von Dynamik – in agilen Teams widmen wir uns den komplexesten Fragestellungen, von KI-gestützter Erdbeobachtung bis zur sicheren Cloud-Architektur. Wer technologische Exzellenz und interdisziplinäre Zusammenarbeit sucht, findet hier das ideale Umfeld.

Unsere Benefits für dich
- Faire Vergütung & Extras: Attraktive Vergütung und individuelle Zusatzleistungen, z. B. betriebliche Vorsorgemodelle, Mobilitätsangebote (bspw. Fahrradleasing) oder Mitarbeitervorteile bei kooperierenden Unternehmen gemäß unseren jeweils gültigen Richtlinien.

- Zeit für dich (und deine Angehörigen): 30 Tage Jahresurlaub gem. Tarifvertrag (35h/Woche); Vereinbarkeit von Familie & Beruf (Gleitzeit, mobiles Arbeiten, Teilzeit, Jobsharing, Sabbatical)

- Weiterkommen leicht gemacht: Ausgezeichnete Weiterbildungsmöglichkeiten und internationale, konzernweite Entwicklungsperspektiven

- Wohlfühlen am Arbeitsplatz: Betriebsarzt; umfassendes Gesundheitsangebot (Sportkurse, Präventionsangebote, uvm.), Kantine und Cafeteria, Kindertagesstätte am Standort

- Vielfalt verbindet: Arbeiten in einem diversen Umfeld, mit mehr als 140 Nationalitäten, in dem Austausch, Unterstützung und Vielfalt gelebt wird

Deine Aufgaben und Verantwortlichkeiten:
- Konzeption und Durchführung von theorie- und datengetriebenen Studien für die simulationsgestützte Operationelle Analyse / Missions-Analyse im militärischen Umfeld

- Entwicklung und Anwendung von Algorithmen der Künstlichen Intelligenz (z.B. Machine Learning, Reinforcement Learning, Multi-Agenten-Systeme) zur Abbildung taktischer Verhaltensbausteine

- Mathematische und algorithmische Modellierung von komplexen Systemen ("Systems of Systems")

- Nutzung, Weiterentwicklung und Implementierung von Algorithmen in unserem hauseigenen Simulations-Framework (C++ und Python) für komplexe Datenanalysen

- Big Data Analytics: Auswertung, statistische Aufbereitung und Visualisierung von großen Mengen an Analyse-Daten sowie deren Präsentation gegenüber internen und externen Kunden

- Erstellung von militärischen Szenarien und Concepts of Operations (CONOPS)

- Verantwortung für die Umsetzung von Arbeitsaufträgen (ggf. Arbeitspaketen) in Zeit, Kosten und Qualität

- Implementierung von Softwareschnittstellen zur Einbindung externer Systeme (HW und SW) in die Simulation

- Unterstützung des technischen Managements von Studien und Projekten sowie bei der Angebotserstellung (u.a. Arbeitspaketbeschreibung, Aufwandsabschätzung)

- Unterstützung der Projektleitung bei Kundenpräsentationen sowie in der Forschungskooperation mit wissenschaftlichen Partnern (Universitäten, Fraunhofer Gesellschaft, etc.)

Erforderliche Kenntnisse und Qualifikationen:
- Erfolgreich abgeschlossenes Studium (Bachelor/Master) in Informatik, Data Science, Angewandter Mathematik, Physik, Luft- und Raumfahrt oder einer vergleichbaren quantitativen Fachrichtung.

- Fundierte Kenntnisse im Bereich Künstliche Intelligenz / Machine Learning (und idealerweise Erfahrung mit Frameworks wie PyTorch, TensorFlow o.ä.).

- Gute bis sehr gute Programmierkenntnisse in Python und C++ sowie Erfahrung in der objektorientierten Softwareentwicklung und komplexen Modellbildung.

- Fundierte Erfahrungen im Bereich theoretischer / statistischer Datenauswertung (Data Analytics, Operations Research, Power BI).

- Idealerweise erste Erfahrungen in der simulationsgestützten Operationellen Analyse von militärischen Szenarien sowie in der Definition von Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) und Measures of Effectiveness (MoEs).

- Idealerweise haben Sie gute Kenntnisse im Bereich von 3D Game Engine-basierten technisch-taktischen Simulationen (wie z.B. Command Modern Operations, C&C, Star Craft, o.ä.) und Spaß am Lösen von taktisch herausfordernden Szenarien – auch durch Agenten-basierte Ansätze.

- Regelmäßige Reisebereitschaft national und international

- Fließende Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse

- Spaß an komplexen (3D-)taktischen Simulationen und theoretischen Systemanalysen

postings.title: System Integration Engineer
postings.legal_entity: 1877 Airbus Defence and Space SAS Taiwan Branch
postings.description:
Job Description:
Airbus has provided integrated security solutions to port authorities, coast guards, national navies, and commercial administrations worldwide for over 20 years. We are looking for some System Integration Engineers based in Taiwan for our maritime surveillance systems. You will join the Maritime Engineering department, where your main mission will be to integrate, verify, validate, and deploy maritime surveillance systems based on STYRIS® product.

STYRIS® is an AIRBUS product that collect, process, consolidate, enrich, and display data from a wide variety of maritime sensors, such as radars, automatic identification systems (AIS), direction finders, cameras, weather stations, etc. STYRIS® is based on a modular system architecture and an ergonomic HMI that allows users to monitor and manage critical maritime situations, as well as communicate quickly with all concerned authorities.

Tasks and Responsibilities -

You will primarily be in charge of system integration and testing at the service command centers or radar sites by performing the following tasks.
• Participate in the installation, deployment, and commissioning of the system
• Participate in system acceptance test sessions with clients
• Potentially participate in client training
• Provide support to maintenance teams

Required Skills and Qualifications

• Bachelor degree or equivalent in computer science or related field.
• Fluent in oral and written English communication skill
• 0 to 3 years of experience in software or system integration
• Linux system administration (mandatory requirements)
• Window system administration
• Linux and Windows scripting languages and deployment tools, like Puppet or Ansible.
• Network configuration
• Test management tools (TestLink, XRay, QTest, etc.)

- Produce Nuclear Hardening analysis and mitigation plans as appropriate, including any relevant test plans

postings.description:
Job Description:
Job Summary:
- Contract: Temporary (12 months)
- Start Date: As soon as possible.
- Location: Bremen
- Compensation: Based on profile and/or experience + Testia employee benefits.
- Reports to: Head of Digital Operations & Quality
- You must attach your resume in English

Context:
We are seeking an experienced professional to fill the position of IT Infrastructure Manager. This key role is responsible for defining the strategy, maintenance, and evolution of the company’s entire global IT infrastructure. The manager will oversee the infrastructure architecture and support the team to ensure autonomous management of operations.

This role will serve as the deputy and substitute for the Director of Digital Operations (IT/IS). You will act as a mentor to the team to foster their professional growth, while ensuring the continuity, security, and efficiency of our digital environment.

Job Responsibilities and Objectives:
A. Management of global infrastructure and IT assets.
Responsible for the full lifecycle and operational availability of all physical and virtual IT assets:
- Strategy:
Establish the strategy, design the architecture, and define IT specifications to ensure the support and robustness of the infrastructure, while managing relationships with key external vendors.

- Equipment Lifecycle:
Manage the full lifecycle (from definition to decommissioning) of computers, phones, printers, and industrial devices. Ensure PC imaging/reimaging, driver management, and OS updates (e.g., WSUS).

- Network architecture and operations:
Design and configure the entire network topology. Manage ISP contracts, VPNs, NAC, and firewall configurations. Monitor network performance and organize maintenance operations.

- Server and Storage Management:
Oversee server hosting, hardware management, OS updates, and network storage solutions. Ensure the implementation and testing of robust backup and restore procedures.

- Virtualization:
Manage the provisioning and maintenance of virtual desktops and VDI environments.

B. Deputy Director of Digital Operations - IT/IS
Serve as the strategic backup for the Director of Digital Operations, ensuring continuity in governance and operations:
- Strategic Planning:
Contribute to the development and execution of the IT/IS roadmap through benchmarking and technology monitoring.

- Operational Governance:
Oversee daily operations and team leadership, including budget planning, financial management, and resource allocation.

- Risk and Contract Management:
Conduct risk analyses and manage contracts/vendors.

- Service Management:
Oversee the Helpdesk structure and incident management. Define and track key performance indicators (KPIs) and service level agreements (SLAs).

- Systems, Applications, and Data:
Coordinate the maintenance and optimization of applications, the ERP system, and software licenses.

- Business Continuity:
Ensure the operational readiness of business continuity plans (BCPs) and disaster recovery plans (DRPs).

What We're Looking For
- Bachelor's or master's degree in Computer Science.
- More than 5 years of experience in infrastructure management and in a senior leadership role.
- Solid knowledge of network topology, server administration (Windows/Linux), virtualization, databases, scripting, cybersecurity standards, and hardware lifecycle management.
- Proven ability to manage budgets, key performance indicators (KPIs), and strategic roadmaps. (Experience with ITIL or similar ITSM frameworks is a plus.)
- At least C1 in English is. (Proficiency in French, or German is a plus.)

- IT Skills:
- SQL, Crystal Reports, Web Services, Linux, and Windows.
- Basic knowledge of databases and database administration.
- Basic knowledge of web languages (e.g., PHP, Python) and scripting.
- Deployment of applications on virtualized and cloud infrastructures (VMWare, Docker, Kubernetes).
- Knowledge of the ISO 27001 standard is a plus.

What We offer
- Flexible Work Hours (Flexible Schedule)
- Remote Work
- Vacation Pay and Christmas Bonus

The Product Service Line "Extended Enterprise" participates actively to these challenges, providing Extended Enterprise solutions which enable Airbus Helicopters Suppliers, Partners, Customers and employees to access AH Information Systems & services from their premises, in-line with stringent commitments on service level agreements and Security company policies.

Within the "IM Infrastructures & Digital Platforms" domain, you belong to the multifunctional team of the Extended Enterprise Product Service Line. You will be welcomed in a dynamic and empowered team, where teamwork and solidarity are key values!

The VDI solution (Virtual Desktop Infrastructure also called VAD standing for Virtual Apps & Desktop) is our major technical product serving our Extended Enterprise business cases (mainly 2D use cases). The VDI solution is also at the core of the transformation of the IT environment of the Product LifeCycle Management (PLM) community answering Design Office engineers' 3D use cases (3DExperience, Catia, …) in the frame of Airbus Digital Design, Manufacturing & Services (DDMS) program.

In that business context the VDI solution being critical for AH company, we are looking for a talent profile to strengthen the team in charge of those solutions.
As the VDI Technology Specialist, you are contributing to both projects and run activities as soon as there is a need to advise and deliver VDI technology working closely with the EE solution architect and the VDI product manager.

How we care for you:

- Financial rewards: Attractive salary, agreements on success and profit sharing schemes, employee savings plan abounded by Airbus and employee stock purchase plan on a voluntary basis.

- Work / Life Balance: Extra days-off for special occasions, holiday transfer option, a Staff council offering many social, cultural and sport activities and other services.

- Wellbeing / Health: Complementary health insurance coverage (disability, invalidity, death). Depending on the site: health services center, concierge services, gym, carpooling application.

- Individual development: Great upskilling opportunities and development prospects with unlimited access to +10.000 e-learning courses to develop your employability, certifications, expert career path, accelerated development programmes, national and international mobility.

At Airbus, we support you to work, connect and collaborate more easily and flexibly. Wherever possible, we foster flexible working arrangements to stimulate innovative thinking.

Your challenges:
You act as the VDI matter Expert and advise about the delivery of this technology and the associated use cases for both Projects & Run.
You collect, research and suggest solutions to address requirements.
You advise on the methodology and implementation approach.
You possess a deep transferable knowledge of VDI new and emerging technologies, including ability to autonomously develop POCs and contribute future IT strategies and standards.

Your key activities:
- To deliver VDI/VAD solutions design and Support solution architects during the definition of the VDI/VAD solution to address business requirements in the frame of projects
- To support in the delivery of POC
- To define the Airbus Helicopters VDI technological orientation axes of both infrastructure and services
- To act as the Airbus Helicopters VDI referent taking part in Airbus Group projects or any cross divisional initiatives involving VDI technology.
- To manage and resolve the most complex technical incident on VDI/VAD serving as the ultimate escalation point and providing in-depth expertise (Marignane and Donauworth Citrix Virtual Apps and Desktops solutions)
- To prove value of VDI new technologies to establish business case and to update the company guidelines and policies regarding the use of VDI technology.
- To advise on specific topics related to the VDI technology.
- To monitor VDI technology and to support the teams to apply these within the Airbus Environment.
- To guide and support the selection of the appropriate VDI technologies.
- To monitor VDI technological trends and to use this knowledge to bring solutions to business to enhance their competitive edge.
- To make recommendations for buy versus build decisions.
- To mentor and to develop team members sharing VDI expertise and contributing to their skill development

Your profile :
As the successful candidate you will be able to demonstrate some of the following skills and competencies:
- Master's degree level (or equivalent) in Information Technology or related field.
- VDI/VAD & Netscaler competencies (Citrix mandatory, Omnissa Horizon is a plus) and confirmed experience in this expertise domain
- Strong IT background (operating systems, network, cyber security) with experience of 5 to 10 years in IT operational environment ensuring the vision and the integration on the IT landscape.
- Good understanding of business requirements, customer service oriented and focus on quality deliverables.

postings.title: Vulnerability Management & Control Efficacy Analyst
postings.description:
Job Description:
Vulnerability Management & Control Efficacy Analyst
The Role
Quantify security effectiveness by moving from qualitative assessments to data-driven risk modeling. You will bridge the gap between technical vulnerability data and financial risk, ensuring that control failures and security gaps are measured, prioritized, and remediated based on their actual business impact.
Key Responsibilities
⦁ Quantitative Risk Modeling: Run Monte Carlo simulations to calculate Annual Loss Expectancy (ALE) and use Bayesian inference to update risk probabilities based on internal vulnerability telemetry and external evidence.
⦁ Vulnerability Life Cycle & Analysis: Collate and track vulnerabilities in a centralized platform, mapping them directly to the corporate security risk register across all divisions.
⦁ Perform multi-dimensional analysis to determine prioritization scores, determining which vulnerabilities require immediate correction based on Threat Intelligence, vulnerability intelligence, and aggregated incident response data.
⦁ Streamline and optimize various vulnerability management processes to reduce "Mean Time to Remediate" (MTTR).
⦁ Governance & Escalation: Support the Security Governance Department with remediation follow-up; continuously monitor risk posture and escalate major risks that exceed the company's risk appetite.
⦁ Control Efficacy: Use Linear Regression to correlate vulnerability metrics (e.g., patch latency) with business downtime and financial loss.
⦁ AI Automation: Apply AI Prompt Engineering to automate KRI/KPI generation using Python/SQL and to interpret complex statistical outputs for executive reporting.
Required Qualifications
⦁ Experience: 4+ years in Cybersecurity, Vulnerability Management, or Quantitative Risk.
⦁ Statistics: Understanding of probability distributions (Lognormal, Poisson, Beta) and statistical significance (p-values, $R^2$).
⦁ Technical Skills: Proficiency in Python or R for data modeling and SQL for querying security telemetry.
⦁ Vulnerability Expertise: Deep understanding of the vulnerability management life cycle, prioritization frameworks (CVSS, EPSS), and technical control failure modes.
Preferred Qualifications
⦁ Frameworks: Proficiency with FAIR (Factor Analysis of Information Risk).
⦁ Cloud: Experience managing security controls in AWS, Azure, or GCP.
⦁ Certifications: CRISC, CISM, or CISSP.
Expected Attributes in a potential Candidate:
1. Adaptive Flexibility: Pivots effectively in response to shifting priorities and organizational change.
2. Intellectual Humility: Values external expertise and prioritizes the best solution over personal ego.
3. Accountability: Takes full ownership of outcomes and focuses on remediation rather than excuses.
4. Critical Thinking: Analyzes objective data to make informed, logical business decisions.
5. Resiliency: Maintains consistent performance and a solution-oriented mindset under high pressure.
6. Effective Communication: Distills complex ideas into clear, actionable information for all stakeholders.
7. Collaborative Orientation: Prioritizes cross-functional goals and team success over individual recognition.
8. Solution-Focused Initiative: Proactively identifies challenges and presents viable resolutions independently.
9. Emotional Intelligence: Navigates interpersonal dynamics with self-awareness and professional tact.
10. Continuous Improvement: Actively seeks feedback and upskilling opportunities to refine performance.
